data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Fuuta fuɗɗam 1. Wurtina innde juulde exact e limngal Steam server AppID. 2. Taƴa laawol jaɓɓorgo serwer ngal haani e folder serwer ngal jaɓɓorgo. 3. Hokka tan ko binndol wi'ugo ɗon wara ɓaawo kuugal. E huutoro tagji support dow to Synix haani hokkugo dabare huutorgo. 4. Suɓo no juulde heɓata fayl jaɓɓorgal. Modu huwteteeɗo ina yiɗi fayl configuration fulfulde e golle, naa misaalu feccere. 5. Taƴi tabbitinki & Ndaarugo. Fuli kooɗume hawtaade ngam warugo. 6. Jaɓɓorgo, jaɓɓorgo Synix, huutorooji masin, ɓaawo ɗon lartol jaɓɓorgo / fuɗugo / stopugo / jaɓɓorgo ngam kuugal.
FULJINGOoje ɗe ɓe yiɗi • Innde ciya: innde huutortooɓe yi'i nder Synix. • ID tagdi: ID tagdi tagdi tagdi tagdi; Synix waɗi ɗum diga innde ciya ngam maaɗa. • Steam AppID: AppID serwer ɓooyma, naa AppID ciya maccuɗo. • SteamCMD app configuring: fuɗɗitol. Goomu GoldSrc AppID 90 jeewte huutoreeji huutoreeji "90 mod folder", bana "90 mod cstrike". Synix ɗon jaɓa tan foomam njamndi. • Fulfulde: misaalu Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Wondira hawtuki folder ngal. • Portji: tabbitinol game default be portji query. • Mappe e laabi ciya: wurtina ko'e ko'e fijirde go'o e nder ko'e. Ɗi ɗon fulɓina suɓaaji ɗi hollata nder waɗugo ko hawrata server.
GOORDE FULJINDE Taa na'i nder kuugal hoore maako. Hokka banndi ɗi juulde ɗon haandi bana ɗerewol je ɗon haandi, nden addana tagji tan ngam ko Synix laarani. Misaalu: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
TAGGO'E DAAWAANDE [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Hokka {rcon} nder huutoreeji fuɗugo to ardiiɗo RCON jaɓetee. Nder RCON syntax, huutore: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Misaalu RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
KONFIGURATION BEhaviour • Ɗu'um ɗon teskaaki: Synix ɗon jaɓataa fayl jaɓɓorgo. • Winndannde caggal nde fuɗɗii: huutoroo jaŋde cappeteeɗo e tawtoreede. • Synix tagi ɗum diga template: Synix taƴi konfigirgal fuu yeeso fuɗɗam. • Puɗɗorgal arguments tan: fijirde ina ɗaɓɓaay jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo ngam waɗugo ɗi.
CHAKKKINDE TEMPLATE TAGS {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} winnda bayyinaaku goonga nde password server ɗon e bayyinaaku ma'a nde password walaa. E huutore Add configuration files to server yiɗi fayl ɓurɗo go'o. Taƴe fayl fuɗɗam ngal fuu, ɓaawo maajum taƴe nokkuure nde ɗum wurtini nder tabere ngam laawol ngol haani yahugo folder server. Synix tawtoree, tawtoree, winnda, tawtoree, e ɓeydagol fayl fuu nder list.
FIILAAJINGOOJINGOOJINGOOJINGOOJINGOoɓe Hokka laawol go'o nder laawol go'o, ha dow folder server ngal maɓɓiti. Ɗuumɗoo faylji ɗi haani fuɗɗitugo haa jooni; faylji ɗi footiima yahugo to ɓe tawi, ammaa meeɗa haɗugo fuɗugo. To faylji ɗi haani ɗon ƴiwo nder fijirde fuɗnaare, holli ko'e kuugal huutorɗo nder kubaruuji Haɓɓugo. Synix meeɗataa jaɓɓude, ɓeydaade jogorgal, koo hokkude fayl mawɗo je ɗon mari lisensi. Foodaaje data fuɗnaange woni innde foodaaje Synix waawi ɗaɓɓitaade nder foodaaje Dokumenti'en huutorɗo. Hokka ɗum meere to huutortoowo foondira fayl'en bee juŋŋgo.
FIRST START WARNING E ICON Hokka hokkugo hokkugo anndal to huutortooɓe foondiraaki haɓɓuki yeeso fuɗugo. Wondondondirɗe laaɓtuɗe e anndina ko goɗɗo yiɗi heɓugo nder kuugal maɓɓe. Icon URL ina jeyaa e waawi huutoreede HTTPS. Synix warata to icon server fulfulde je wurtinaama nde ɗum laato.
WURNugol e jamma Fuɗɗita defte kese e template ha revision 1. Ɓeyda jaɓɓorgo nanondiral nde nanondiral nanondiral nanondiral nanondiral. Ɓeyda waylude template tan to jaɓɓorgal jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo. Synix ɗon haɓɓa ɓeydaaki ɓeydaaki ɓeydaaki boo ɗon hokka tagdi ɓeydaaki.
POT-INSTALL OPTION Hokkaaki Steam jaaynde jaaynde jaaynde tan to server'en hujjaama ngam ɗaɓɓugo ɗum. Luttugal ngal waawi wonde foodaaɗo nder nder server ngal. Synix tawtoree tan DLL's Steam runtime tati je ɗon haandi.
Ɗuɓɓudi sahaa Hokka dabare fooyre RAM to 0 to jokkondiral walaa fooyre tabbitunde. hardware e Windows Jaɓɓorgo time runtime baylitta ko haani yeeso setup e taƴugo jaɓɓorgo naawɗo; ɓe ngalaa waylude Windows. Taɓo .NET Framework malla Visual C++ runtime tan to ko haɓɓii e dowlaaji game'en. Synix ɗon ɗaɓɓita diiwaan Windows, ammaa naa ɗon maɓɓita koo ɗon jaɓɓa ko haani. Hyper-V yiɗi Windows Professional ko ɓuri, ngam non suɓugo Hyper-V boo suɓii ko Windows yiɗi.
HINNAANDE fuɗde naftoroo jaɓɓorgo kuugal fuɗɗam ngam serverji feere-feere. Ɗuɓɓugo ɓesngu fuɗɗam waɗii tan ngam jaɓɓugo, masin virtuwal, malla ɓesngu fuɗɗam go'o jogori nguurndam nguurndam server; ɗum ɗon sakkitoo jaɓɓorgo warugo. Haɓɓitaaki jaɓɓorgo booɗugo ngam juulde ɗe jaɓɓorgo server ngal haani yaawde. Ɗu'um fuɗɗitiri ɓesngu ɓoyma ɓoyma ɓoyma ɓoyma ɓoyma ɓoyma ɓoyma ɓoyma. Ɓeydaaki fuɗɗugo ɗon hawta tan ngam .exe, .bat, e .cmd fuɗɗugo fayluuji. Hokka jaɓɓorgo fayl fuɗnaango tan to huutortoowo waawata waɗugo e jaɓɓorgo fayl fuɗnaango booɗnaango ɓaawo Synix. Ɗuum habaru ɗon holla ɓaawo huutoreeji habaru masin ɗi ciya ɗon heɓata. Ɗi fannuuji ɗi suɓii jokkondirɗe Synix je ɗon haɓɓita, nden ɓe mbaawataa huuwugo scriptji walla plugins je ɗon haɓɓita.
LOG DISCOVERY Wurtina laabi tabbitol ha nder folder server ngal maɓɓi. E huutore * ngam laawol go'o tagdi malla innde fayl e ** ngam foodaaje ɓooyɗe. Ko'e jooɗotooɓe nokku je ɗon laɓɓina ko {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, e {QueryPort}. Misaalu: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix ɗon ɗaɓɓita laawolji ɗi tan to liloowo yiɗi maɓɓitugo kuugal ɓurngal.

Ɓooyre fayluuji server ɗon hawrata arande; faylji fuɗɗii fuɗnaama ɗon hawrita ngam warugo. Dunyaaji e add-ons ɗon halki. Waɗugo jaɓɓorgo fulfulde yeeso tuubuki juulde. Walaa server juulde fuɗɗii.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Kuutoro huutorgal ngol ngam waɗugo server maaɗa arande. Synix ɗon huuwa ɗum nder komiwal ngal, ngam non acci komiwal ngal wakkati yimɓe ɗon mooɓta. On hewtanay windi umroore fuɗugo ngam jaɓɓorgo goɗɗum.
1. Fuli Synix nden laatake SteamCMD jaɓɓorgo dependency fini. 2. Taƴi Add Server, nden maɓɓita server keso. To defte server ɗon woodi, suɓi Import Existing Server. 3. E nder General, addani innde server feere-feere nden suɓii game. Taƴa ko'e maɓɓe, suɓaa ko'e maɓɓe, ko'e maɓɓe, ko'e maɓɓe. 4. Hokka ko ɓe mbi'i, sey to a yiɗi feere. Yi'a limɗe setup je ɗon haɓɓii e warugo haala ko haani haɓɓitaago dow. 5. Suɓii Save Server. Ɗu'um ɓeydi ngol to dashboard; ɗum firtaaki ko juulde timmini rakki. 6. Taƴi ngol e suɓii fuɗɗam. Hokka jaɓɓorgo e fuɗɗol haɓɓugo ngam timmaade, jokkondirgo dow ko Synix holli. 7. Fulfulde setup kooɗume je laamɓe juulde, bana alkawal, log-in account, malla waɗugo session nder server manager nder juulde. 8. Wondira diga PC ɗemngal ngal koo masin nder network wuro maaɗa. To ɗum huutori, waɗu backup yeeso ɓeydaago mods malla waɗugo baylitol mawɗi.
To A Waawataa Wondugo Haɓɓo Yahugo ngam server je ɓe cuɓii e jaŋde Activity & Diagnostics. Ɗaɓɓo ko'e fijirde toɗɗaaɗe toɗɗaaɗe. Ngam Minecraft malla Satisfactory, kubaruuji game guides ɗon holla laabi ɗi ɓeydi.
Goomu ngam yimɓe fuɗɗiiɓe nder network maaɗa ko darnde go'o nder networking. Ko fuɗɗii hollude ko server'en ɗon huwtore dow nokku.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Kala darnde dashboard ina yiɗi innde mum e folder installation. Synix wurtini innde server nder anndal Windows-walluɗum ngam wallugo folder e launch settings. Ɗu'um ɗon halki misaalu'en diga darnugo faylji fuɗɗam; ɗum naa masin virtuwal malla dammugal jammu.
LONGOO DEFALT • C:\Synix ?? main Synix data workspace. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD ?? downloader game shared. • C:\Synix\Games\<game>\<server> ?? installation servers normal. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ?? root backup normal. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? logji ñawu e warngooji nyau.
MSI app files ɗon nder %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Woɓɓe fijirdeeji e ko Windows-ji ɗon darii boo to account Windows.
Duniyaaji Customs Eertina Install & Launch to tawtoree folder server. Ngam jaɓɓorgo keso, suɓii foodaaɗo windaaɗo e woodi nokkuure ɗuuɗunde ngam juulde e ɓeydaaki. Taa taƴo tagdi ɗiɗo to go'o nder go'o.
Open Server Folder ɗon holla nokkuure gooŋgaaje server laato. Open Backup Folder ɗon holla nokkuure ceede maako; taa ma'ana laawol go'o nder innde maako.
Faylaji danndaaɗi mbaawi wonde to feere Ciyaare waawaa rokkude duniyaaru nder AppData, Dokumentiiji, gariiri feere, malla sistemam huɓɓugo mum. Tabitinii nokkuure jaɓɓorgo asli juulde nden ka ɓeydaaki ko'e yahugo.
Ɗuum fuɗɗituki ko'e fuɗnde nder Fiil Explorer ɗon tabitake wonde ko'e laabi je ɗon hoolaama ɗon ɓeyda. E huutoroo Synix's supported import/transfer workflow be review paths ha yeeso fuɗɗam. Ɗuum haalaaji feere-feere foondiraaki boo portol networgal ngal hawtaaki.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers huutorooɗo Server Dedicated Server Manager mum, ko Synix waawi waɗugo ɗum yi'eteeɗum. Nde fuɗɗii maɓɓugo, suɓi Local/Console, suɓi Continue to server configuration, addani server e duniyaaru, nden suɓi Save & start. Kuutoro mawɗo for advanced settings, worlds, mods, administrators, e console maako. Synix ɗon hokka haala man nder folder Instance server'en. Fedde fuɗɗam Local/Console warata hakkeeji jaagorɗo; haɓɓugo kuugal Windows ɗon waɗa. Ɗuum ko .NET Framework 4.8 walla ɓesngu, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 e 2017, maa 6 GB nder sistem RAM, e UDP port 27016 yahugo laawol Firewall Windows nden yahugo nder router ngam yiilooji internet. Jaɓɓorgo Kewuuji pinal: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Wattdog ɗon hakkiilo kuuɗe server je anndi e waawata fuɗɗugo warugo ngam warugo ɓaawo yahugo ɓurɗum meeɗaade malla hallude.
NORMAL OPERATION Kuutoro Synix' s Stop and Restart controls for deliberate changes. Synix ɗon jokkondira kuuɗe ɗe bee dogol laɓɓinol ngam jaɓugo yahugo naa' ɗum haani bana nyau.
Wonduki tagaarol ciya, maɓɓugo ɗum nder Task Manager, malla halkiɗum nder manager go'oto waawataa yi'ugo ngam warugo.
FULNDE FULNDE FULNDE Saki server ngal to Synix, nden ndaara ko ɓooyi nder kuugal. Tabitinki sahaa fuɗugo, haɓɓuki, port, memory, malla mod hawtaade ngam fuɗɗugo. Warugo waawataa warugo mod mo hawtaaki bee maɓɓe koo gootol jeewte.
Kuɓol kuugal e ƴamol duɗal woni caɗeele feere. Wakkati warugo ɗon hawta dow ciya e haala ɓaawo, ngam maajum toɗɗitaako warugo fuu bee naftoraago wakkati go'o.
Limite Synix ɗon ɗaɓɓita jaɓɓooji ɗi ɗon wallita e kuuɗe ɓikkoy je ɗon jeyaa to server. Masini'en virtuol je ɗon jaɓɓorgo daga fuɗɗam ko'e masinji walla kuugal hawrugo yahuɓe waawi ɓeydagol jaɓɓugo nden ɗon yiɗi jaɓɓugo ɗi nder ciya.
Jaɓɓorgo dabareji jaɓɓorɗe je ɗon tabbitina wala aynugo jaɓɓorgo je ɗon waylita ha cakka fuɗɗam maɓɓol.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Ɗuum naftoraaki ɗemɗe nguurndam nguurndam Synix ngam huutore server. Ɗu'um ɗon walli tagdi ngam anndugo tagdi e tagdi.
START Taƴa ko'e maɓɓoore nden taƴa Start once. Synix ɗon ɗaɓɓa ko haani, laawol, portji, e jaɓɓorgo yeeso fuɗugo, ɗon hawrita faylji ɗi ɗon maaki, nden ɗon hawtoro server. Ngaree foondiral yeeso tiitooɗugo.
STOP Suɓii Stop e hokkuugo sahaa juulde ngam hisnaago e maɓɓugo. Synix huutoroo jaɓugo ɓesngu dow ɗo woodi, nden to haani, jaɓugo ɓesngu dow laawol. Fuuɗugo fuɗɗam yaawde heɓuki ɓamtaare.
RESTART Taƴa fuɗɗitugo ngam halkugo goomu kuutorgol jooni nden fuɗɗitugo haala keso. Ndaa fuɗɗitugo go'o feere bee juuɗe nder wakkati ɗu'um ɗon waɗa.
To BUTTON WORT WAAWAY Gooto kuugal waawaa jaɓugo serwer ngal, darnde ina waawi wonde nder darnde jaɓɓorgo, maa ko yiɗde ina waawi huutoraade darnde feere. Njaŋge haala kuugal e ko'e maral ngal.
Toɗɗita mbarugo server nder Task Manager ko toɗɗitaago ɗum diga masin ngam kuɓuki ordinar. Ɗu'um waaway yi'ugo bana waylaaki ɓaawo ɗon, o waawataa warugo.
Ciwɗi je ɗon jaɓɓorgo nder masinji virtuol malla ciwɗi jaɓɓorgo bana fuɗɗaaɓe ngam jaɓɓorgo, ɗon mari nafoore maɓɓe ngam jaɓɓorgo nguurndam. Jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo ngal hollaayi kuugal ngal fuɗɗii.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory ɗon ɗaɓɓa haɓɓuki fuɗɗam nder Server Manager nder ciya. Synix waawata haɓɓitaade e fuɗɗugo server darnde, amma waawataa jeytaade server'en ko haɓɓitaade session maɓɓe.
Caggal ko'e nder juulde 1. Hinta ko Satisfactory e fuɗɗita ɗum e Synix. 2. Ngaree ngam server marɗo hokkugo ma'ajugo. 3. Open Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager nden add ko suɓugo server. 4. Ɗo'o wi'a, hokkuki password jaangoowo, nden loggo bana jaangoowo. 5. Foondite ko yiɗi huutoreede.
Synix ɗon jaɓɓa fuɗnaaki/fuɗnaaki fuɗnaaki, hawti e fuɗnaaki fuɗnaaki e MaxPlayers. Ɗuum ɗemɗe ɓooyɗe e nder FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
CONNECT SYNIX 1. Hokka server huwtoree bee -NewConsole. Check jaayɗe importirɗe malla ɓuriiɗe; to a ɓeydi huutore nden, fuɗɗita bee Synix. 2. E huutoree ko'e Windows ngam Synix e server, ɓuri heewde hakkillaaji huutortooɓe. 3. Taƴo serwer ngal eɓɓo Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Taƴi hokkugo masin go'o e ɗon.
Synix ɗon nelda server.GenerateAPIToken, ɗon jaŋgo ko'e keso fuu, ɗon tabbitina API je ɗon haa nokkuure nden, e ɗon hokka tagdi ɓeydaaki ngam daliila Windows ma. Token hokkata jaɓɓorgo ardiiɗo, wonaa tan jaɓɓorgo.
Winndannde caggal Token verified and saved securely and opens Overview On meeɗaay jaɓugo ko'e nder console koo hokkude tagdi bee juuɗe.
To footi footi, Synix ɗon hokkita jokkondirɗum ɓaawo maajum, nden naa' o fuɗɗitiri footi. Janngee ko'e ma'a yeeso to a ɗaɓɓi ɗum.
Ɗu'um ɗon hawta to server laato dow PC ndu'u; ko haani darnde router keso ngam Synix. Normal Start, Stop, and Restart still work without a API Token.

data.value:
Taƴi tagdi dow dashboard nden maɓɓita Sarɗiiji Server. Fuu huutorooje je ɗon jaɓɓa dow tagdi nden e haala maako jooni ɗon hokkata.
FIILAAJJI E KUMAANDE • Open Server Folder e Open Backup Folder ɗon maɓɓita nokkuuje ɗon. • Jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo. • Update Server downloads update game support. • Fulfulde game files checks ko warata faylji je ɗon jaɓetee e jaɓɓorgo. • Backup and Restore ɗon hokka tagdi ko haani. • Create Batch File ɗon wurtina script fuɗugo to profile'en ɗon wallita ɗum. • Delete ina ƴettude jaaynde nden ɗon hokkata tan suɓaaji ƴettude fayl ɗi ɗon holla nder tabbitinol ngol.
LINJIILAAJI E GOLLIILAAL Linjiila Wonnugo hollata addressji, portji, e copy kuugal. Kuɗol hawtaade, Mod & Plugin Manager, Minecraft kuuje, e Satisfactory Control Center ɗon waŋgina to ɓe ɗon wallina.
INSPECT A RUNNING SERVER Ɗowtake ɗiɗawre nder row for server details. Winndannde yeesoNaaɓirɗe Fulfulde ɗon holla fuɗɗooje, host console, e kuuɗe kuugal je ɗon haandi nder ngol winndannde. Ciwgal ɓurngal huutore waawi woodi ID huutore go'o.
E huutorooɗo kuugal ngam yi'ugo CPU server nden e taariika memory. Ɗi'e jaayndeeji ɗi'en ɗon feere to sammuɗum PC fuu nder dashboard.
Ɓooyugo baylitol ko'e kuutorgal ngam hakkilantaaki kuugal ngal. Kuutoro kuuɗe dow dashboard to ɗum woni yiɗi ma.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Suɓo edition Minecraft arande suɓugo mods malla setting connection. Java e Bedrock ngoni serweruuji feere-feere; Bedrock naa'a laatoowo Java.
SETTING THE SERVER 1. Hokka tagdi Minecraft nden suɓi Java malla Bedrock. 2. Ngam Java, suɓee version Minecraft, loader, e version loader hawtaama hokketeeɓe. 3. Yi'a duniyaaru, laabi fijirde asli, limti gamer, memory, portji, e fannuuji jamma. 4. Jaɓɓorgo e fuɗɗugo nder Synix. 5. Kaŋko a jaɓan alkawal koo fuɗugo fuɗugo. 6. Tawa haa duniyaaru timminirta ɓamtude, nden hawta bee jaaynde jaaynde e jaaynde. 7. Wonduki nder duniyaaru kuuɗe yeeso ɓeydude mods.
Java e BEDROCK Yiɗde Java hawti e Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, e Purpur to ɗum haani. naftoraade version e maɓɓitaaki tagdi; Paper e Purpur naftorooji plugins, nde Fabric, Forge, e NeoForge naftorooji modol maɓɓe. Synix ɗon jaɓɓa wakkati huutore diga marɗo maako.
Bedrock huutoroo jaaynde Bedrock Dedicated Server package e huutoroo Java.
HINDE Ɗe Firooje Suɓaa loader ko moodi'en yiɗi. Ɗuɓɓugo Minecraft version, loader, dependences, e ko haani dow ɓaawo client.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, e plugin-server packages naa'e footi. Hokka moodi walla plugin folder naa wurtina loader ko haani koo server framework. Browse Catalog naa' ɗum modpack wala dependency installation automatic.
FULNugol Haɓɓitaade ɗon jaɓɓa server.properties e foondooji feere-feere. Java boo ɗon hokkata laawol Spectator. Fuuji e dowlaaji Technical keep the form Minecraft expects.
Daga Firooje Server, maɓɓita Minecraft Control Center. Jaɓɓorgo Tabitol maako ɗon holli faylji tagdi ɗi server'en mbaawata hawrugo. Edit File ɗon hokkuki jaɓɓorgo ɗerewol; Hawritaaku hawritaaku hawritaaku hawritaaku hawritaaku hawritaaku hawritaaku Ɗuum ɗiɗo fuu ɗon rokkata baylitol nder wakkati server ɗon halki. Ko anndiraa server.properties ɓesnguji bano ports, player limit, duniyaaru, seed, mode, e command-channel setting kadi update Synix's saved entry. Ɗuum innde/MOTD je anndaa e innde nafoore nden. Fedde mod anndaaɓe ɗon jooɗi nder defte mum'en.
Synix ɗon jaɓɓa ɗeen settinguji yeeso hawrugo ko wurtini, e to ɓe ɗon naftira Refresh wakkati ɓe ɗon halki. To deftere fuɗɗore nde'e walaa maaki malla ɗon hawta bee defte feere, sakkake caɗeele nde'e nder nokkuure nde'e fuɗɗoroo server. Jaɓɓorgo Fedde Ɓamtaare Fedde Ɓamtaare Fedde Ɓamtaare maɓɓiti ɗum ngam maɓɓitugo ko ɓesdi.
BINNAANGO WORKING THE SERVER Hokka tagdi server fulfulde yeeso waylude version'en malla loader'en. Taƴi sahaa fuɗugo keso nder Settup, soodi sahaa fuɗugo, nden taƴi Apply Runtime in Minecraft Control Center. Synix ɗon hawrita sahaa fuɗɗam, ɗon hokka server.properties e foodaaji duniyaaru, e ɗon jaɓɓina faylji sahaa fuɗɗam. Ɗum fuɗɗitataa server'en masin. Fuɗugo ɗon sakkinaa to wakkati huwtoreeji e profiil je ɓe suɓii ɗon hawta.
Rollback fayl naa wurtina baylitol duniyaaru waɗata caggal nde server fuɗɗii. Taa tammi duniyaaji je ɗon maɓɓiti bee Minecraft ɓurɗum ɓesngu malla modji feere-feere waawi daɓugo ngam wakkati huutore ɓurii; haɓɓuɓe ɓesngu fulfulde haade.
Saki ngam darnugo faylji je haani fuɗugo. Taa jeyta duniyaaru woodi bee template kesam bana laawol laaɓɗum ngam ceede.
To jokkondirɓe mbaawaa jokkude Jaɓɓorgo edition, game/loader version, mod required, and the actual port/protocol of the selected edition. Ngam wurtingol ɓaawo, ɗaɓɓita nder kuugal game for agreement, runtime, memory, or dependency errors.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Fuligo Satisfactory Control Center ɓaawo hawtingol API local. Taɓɓi tabbitinol ngam kuuɗe ɗe ngaɗata.
Fuuɗuki Yiɗee Refresh ngam yi'ugo innde session, limngal jokkere hawtiɗo/maaki, haala fijirde, dabare tick, wakkati fijirde, e darnde technology.
Dashiboard player limti update automatically saa'i hawtaaki ɗon e semmbe; Tabital jaŋde ɗon ɓeyda dow dow dow dow dow dow. API ɗo hokkata limti, naa limtinirɗum. Ɗu'um saɗtuki ko'e server ɗo ɗon ɗaɓɓi saɗtuki ko'e saɗtuki.
SETTINGS SERVER Taƴi Refresh, taƴi ko'e jaɓɓorɗe, ɓaawo maajum Fulfulde ceertuɗe. Yiɗugo foondirɗe ɓaleeɓe caggal ɓesngu. Footi footi fuɗɗoraaki; jaɓɓorgo waylital ngal fuɗɗitataa jokkondirde.
Setting key'en e darajaji jaɓaama ɗon haani nder ɗemngal kuugal ngal.
Fijirdeji danndaaɗi • Soofugo jooni: Taƴi innde malla huutoro innde Synix. Ɗuuruki innde ina waawi wurtina defte jaɓɓorɗe. • Ɗuɓɓugo ɓurna: Yiya jaaynde. Synix ɗon hokka ɓamtaare ɓaawo nde juulde ɗon haani; loading waawata wurtina jokkereeji. • Upload save: Hokka fayl mo suɓaama nden waawataa darnugo fayl mo suɓaama. Ɗu'um ɗon wurtina ɗum masin. • Daartol ko haɓɓii: Ɗuurɗina go'o to laawol ngal a suɓii.
Waɗde goɗɗum ko haani yeeso to ɓe ngaddani koo ɓe ngaddani duniyaaru mawndu. Saving transfers have a 512 MB safety limit. API waawataa heɓugo wakkati seedi.
FULNDE FULNDE Wurtina go'o dowla juulde nder sahaa e jaŋde hokkugol. Scripts, token/password commands, e haɓɓitol jaɓɓaago ɗon sakkiti haa ɗo.
Luttugol stop support e nder Synix's stop workflow. Lamargal tagdi ɗon jooɗorugo nder tagirol ngol, naa nder tagirol tagirol walla logji ɗemngal Synix; ko'e mayre nden waawataa winndude defte mum'en.

To server'en anndini ɓeydaago ko woodi nder ɓaleeɓe ɗuuɗuɗi malla ɓooyde to ɓe ngaddani maapuji boo ɓe ngaɗani ɗum, haɓɓita Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer to Steam ngam huutoreede ko o mari. Jaɓɓorgo MPsrc ɓesngu ɓesngu nder fijirde ndee to fayde serwer ngal, e holla mapcycle.txt e maplist.txt ɗon hawta mappe ɗe ngaɗata.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo Connect automatically before retrying. Luttugo je ɗon waŋgina nder console game ɗon hollata naa' ngam jaɓugo tagdi, tabbitinol, e jaɓɓugo fuu footi.
FIIRANDE Ɓaleeɓe • Console naa heɓaaki: Tabitin -NewConsole, server je ɓe cuɓii, e huutoreeji jaɓɓorgo Windows. • Luttugol ngal fuɗɗiima e nder faandaare: Fuli ɗum hoore maa. Synix waawataa winndude ɗum. • Command runs amma token walaa capture: Let start finish, check writeable game logs, and allow complete fresh output to arrive. • Filtere'en ɗon hawta: Wurtina filtere'en hawta/wurtina e laatina console'en jaaboto. • Port API yahugo nder laawol go'o: Jaɓɓorgo port fijirde jeewte nder serwer mo ɓe cuɓii. To' on neldi ko'e mooɗon to goɗɗo nanɗo ɗum. • Token taggitaama koo hokkugo jokkondirol waawataa sakkugo: Fulfulde jokkondirol jokkondirol, nden hokkugo jokkondiri. • API walaa: Ngaree ngam fuɗugo ko'e maɓɓitaare nden ndaarondira ko'e kuugal.
Jaabawol kesal ina waawi hawtaade e foondiral ngal no jaabawol fuɗɗam waɗi. Capture huutorooji output taggi diga ɓaawo umroore, naa token mawɗo nder log.
WONDE OR WONDE WONDE WONDE Satisfactory wurtini tagdi mawɗo nder console mum e logs. Hokka ɗe go'o e ƴiɓɓina ko'e tagdi daga fotooji e nder kubaruuji.
Synix ɗon tabbitina wonde endpoint local'en yahugo server je ɓe cuɓiri e pin certificate maako. Taa sakkugo kuutoreeji certification ngam warugo fijirde.
Jaɓɓorgo Ɓamtaare Token Synix" ko haɓɓii; ɗum wurtataa tagdi nder server.
To revoke existing application tokens, huutoro server.InvalidateAPITokens in Satisfactory'hoore server console ko Server Manager console. Ɗu'um ɗon hawta kadi hawtuki feere huutoreeji huutoreeɓe token'en.
Ngam koode Windows feere malla jaɓɓorgal fuɗɗam, hokketeeɗum boo to hokkugo jaɓɓorgo je ɗon haani naftoraago.

Fuuɗugo dow koo go'o hawtaaki, hokkugo account, tagdi tagdi, ko haɓɓii e nder ciya. 4. Ngam mods, nanngina ciya, loader, dependences, e ko client yiɗi. 5. Launcher je ɗon jooɗi footi jooɗa ɓaawo jaɓɓoowo je goonga majjini. Server je ɗon boɗɗum footi maɓɓita ngam looting duniyaru mala woodi ƴamol je wala/API. Yi'a ko larni ɗi'i feere-feere.
STOP OR RESTART ɗon wara wakkati Ciwɗi ɗon ɗaɓɓita wakkati ngam humpitooɓe e maɓɓugo kuuɗe maɓɓe. Ngaree footi Synix'en e janngude mbayliigu mum. Ɓaɗol fuɗɗitol waawaa ɓeydaago yeeso.
Taa halki kuje ɗon e ɗon, fuɗɗita koode feere, malla huutorooɗo feere dow kuje ɗon.
Nafoore malla go'o ɗon maaya Jaɓɓorgo potal profil e haala jooni. Woɓɓe suɓaaji ɗon halki ngam juulde ɗon mari maɓɓe malla walaa laawol jaɓɓorgo ɗon woodi. N/A player data's naa'a automatically a server failure.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
wurtina mala ɓesda modpack server 1. Waɗde jaɓɓorgo server fulɓe e halki server ngal. E huutore Synix bee hakkilooji Windows je ɗon haandi. 2. Seti e huutoree ko Minecraft version, loader, e loader build. 3. Nder Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, suɓi Import Server Pack. Yiɗugo Modrinth .mrpack malla ZIP server fulfulde hawtigo mods/plugins asli e faylji configuration. 4. Moodji serverji je footi laarama sey ni to a suɓi Include optional server mods. Wattinolji Modrinth je jaɓɓoowo tan e jaɓɓorɗe jaɓɓoowo ɓeydaaka. 5. Yi'a jaɓɓorgo scan, metadata checks, content skiped, e kala fayl to ɓeydanaama, suɓaa, ko woɗɗitaama. Tabitin tan to fuɗɗoode nden e baylitol ngol haani. 6. Fuɗɗita e juuɗe caggal ɗum, nanngi console, be lartol hawtaade maccuɗo.
Maajinoowo naftirtaako ɗemɗe fuɗnaango nder pakki, naftirtaaki duniyaaru, malla naftirtaaki root server.properties. Download pakki server fulfulde mawɗo to jaaynde CurseForge client export ɗon hawti tan e manifest download. Downloadji goɗɗi, hostji ɗi ngaɗataa jaɓɓorgo, koo loaders ɗi ngaɗataa jaɓɓorgo ɗaɓɓitoto faylji serverji ɗi mawɗo jaɓɓorgo yiɗi; Synix ɗon foofta hakkillaaji marɓe.
Modrinth downloads ɗon hash-check. Metadata JAR je ɗon jaɓɓa ɗon lartake ngam laɓɓinol, ɓesngu client tan, IDji duplicate, be tagdi je ɗon anndina diga jugo JAR. Metadata anndaaɗum e laabi feerootiral ɓurɗi foondugo foondugo. Ɗuɓɓuki laaɓtuɗum ko walaa ko haani huutoreeɗum ɗon tabbitina mod goɗɗum ko haani koo ko haani. Ɗu'um ɓeydaaku ɗon du'a jaɓugo nder ɓernde.
Ɗu'um fuɗɗituki jaɓɓorgo biyeteeɗo ɗon waawata sakkinki JAR'en ɗi ɗonno woodi, ammaa tan to fayl'en ɗi ɗon hawta bee hash'en ɗi ɗum wurtini. JAR'en e fayluuji duniyaaru ɗi ɓe njogitaaki ina laaɓtataa. Defte Configuration haɓɓiiɗe nder pakkere keso ina waawi jeytaago defte ɓurii; tawtoreeɓe ɗon holla ɓe yeeso on ɗon anndina. Hokka innde fayl server-ZIP gootol to ɓeydaaki pakke nden ngam ɗum anndina bana pakke boo.
DUNIYAAL DUNIYAAL E huutoree Dunyaaji ngam anndude dunyaaji ɗi anndaama. Jaɓɓorgo Duniyaa ZIP jaɓɓorgo go'o e jaɓɓorgo go'o e nder deftere innde kesum; ko wurtinaaki aduna woodi koo waylittaaki hakkunde Java e Bedrock. Taɓɓi duniyaru ɗon haɓɓaa e Activate World ngam waylude innde darnde e duniyaaru Synix. Ɗo fuɗɗam ɓaawo ɗon ɗon haɓɓoo duuniyaaru. Ceerno seed ɗon wallita ɓesngu duuniyaaru kesam, naa nokkuuje ɗon ɗon.
FULNugol Recovery lists files changes made by this workspace. Undo hokkata fayluuji ɓooɗeeɗi ɗi jaɓɓii koo waylata fayluuji ɗi waylitii bee waylitol ngol. Ɗaɓɓitaaki duniyaaru fuɗnaaku yeeso tuugugo lesdi fuɗnaaku. To fayl'en ngaɗake haŋkadi, Synix ɗon haɓɓa wurtugo ɗi. hokka jaayndeeji e huutoree ko fotti e jaayndeeji to haani.
Jaɓɓorɗe jaɓol je ɗon laɓɓina fuɗɗam haa nde jaɓol timmi be jaɓɓorɗe je ɗum resani hawti be jaɓɓorɗe je ɗum jaɓɓi. Lappolji je ɗon ɓada je wala kujeji jaawal je winda ɗon mari haaje jaawal je timmi ngam jaawal jaawal. Backups ɗon laato backups je kuude-server, je wala limtolji feere-feere.
Winndannde caggal Ɓeydaade Backup Fulfulde, jaayndeeji jaayndeeji kuugal kollitii wondi ko darnde backup. Ɓe ɗon haaje ngam huutoreede, ammaa ɓe mbaawataa wurtugo dow defte je ɓe maɓɓiti. Naɓuki ko'e jaɓɓorgo ko'e warugo ɓaawo warugo ɗon tagi jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo kesi.
DIGNOSTICS e CEDULES Nafoore nanondira ko'e jaaynde e jaaynde warugo dow Java, memory, dependency, port, duniyaaru, be caɗeele time tick. Walaa laabi huutoreeɗi ɗon holla daliila server'en booɗugo. Kuugal fuɗɗortooji huutortooji; CPU e RAM fuɗnaaki ngam haɓɓugo game tick profile.
Kalluuji maɓɓitiri Synix's hawruki fuɗugo e jaɓugo huutoraade. Suɓo nyalɗe ko yiɗi, sahaa, jokkondirol ɓaleejo, backup, e jaɓɓorgo fursatuuji, nden ɓe ndaari e jaɓɓorgo. Ɗuum nokkuure kuugal naa' foofta kalfinaajo ɗiɗaɓo koo waylita kalfinaaji maa.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Taƴe server Minecraft, nden maɓɓo Server Options → Minecraft Control Center. Kuulal Console e Players ɗon hawrita kuugal dowla e kuugal mawɗo bee maɓɓe. Peeje goɗɗe ɗon hokkuki tagdi, duniyaaru, add-ons, backup server fulɓe, fuɗɗitol kalkal, warugo, e lartol.
CHANNEL'EN LAMBI'EN Firooji ɗi ɓe nganndi ina mbaawi huutoreede konsole Synix, channel jaɓɓorgo localhost, malla RCON je ɓe nganndi. Ɗuum channel yahugo ɗon jeyaa e jaaynde nden e server.
Daande mawɗo ɓoyɗo waawi sakkinugo channel dowla go'o haani. To controls ɗon halka, tabbitin ko server'en ɗon huuwugo e jaɓɓorgo maako ɗon haani.
CHAKKKINGOOJI DULLE To ɗum jaɓaama, Synix ɗon hokkata habaruji, limte ɓaleeɓe, darnuki, waylitol jaajotooɗo e limte, hakkillaaji wakkati/laati, e humpitol.
Taƴa ko haani waɗugo e jaŋde nden kaɓirɗe ngam anndude ɗum. Ngam hokkugo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo. Taa hokke ɗum ngam hallude caɗeele.
COOMMENTS RAW Kuutoro ko hawti e nder deftere nden. Kuje bana list e save-all ɗon hawta nder fijirde e ɓe ngalaa baylitol bee interface Synix. Ndaa dokkal jokkondirol ngol yeeso sendugo dokkal ngal waylitiri duniyaaru walla hakkillaaji.
COUNTS E NAME Askarol waawata hokkugo limgal mawɓe ɓe walaa list anndinaama. Tabital innde fuɗɗii hollataako wonde hay gooto hawtaaki.
E huutoroo dow dashboard Stop ko Reboot for life-cycle changes so watchdog anndi shutdown ɗum anniya.
Jaɓɓorgo RCON mala darndeji jaangirde je ɗon ha wakkere man sey ni to on mari dabareji jaɓɓol woɗɗugo. Jaɓɓorgo Gameplay don mari haaje wurtinugo tinndolji ko'e malla darnde.

14. Duuɗal e sirlude hawtaade e yahugo

data.value:
Ɗaɓɓa dow row server ngam huutoree controls dow. Ɗuum laamiije je ɓe suɓii ɗon taƴa server gootol ɗi kuugal ɗon hawta.
Hokka Gooduɗo Kuugal E huutoroo nder fannu ɗaɓɓugo ngam fiiltarugo bee innde game malla server. Filtira status ɗon ɓeyda limtinki limtinki. To tagdi ɗon yi'a ɓeydi, laaɓa filtri ɗiɗaɓu ngam tammuugo ɗum wayliti.
Janngina ko haalan • Servers je ɗon haɓɓii ɗon taƴa nder servers je ɗon haɓɓii. • Running Now ɗon holla kuuje ɗe ɗon haalde bana kuuje. • CPU Usage e RAM Usage holli PC fuu, naa Synix tan. • Bayyinaaji gamɓe ɗon haaji tan to fijirde je ɓe suɓii ɗon holli foondiral gootol.
KINNAANDE WONDOO • Fuɗuki, Stop, e Reboot ngam jaɓugo server mo suɓaama. • Configure waftini fannuuji setup. • Ɗuɗal ɗon ɗaɓɓita daliilaji ɗi mbaawataa huuwugo. • Server Options ɗon hawta fayl, jaɓɓorgo, hawtaade, e kuutorɗe feere-feere. • Ɗaɗita ɗiɗaɓo dow laamiije ngam yi'ugo server ngal ɓeydi ɓeydi.
Activity & Diagnostics holli ɓamtaare e habaruji je ɗon haani. Janngina bolle ɓurɗe warugo yeeso ma'a fuɗugo kuuɗe. CLEAR ɗon laaɓɓa nokkuure kuugal booɗɗum; ɗum wonaa umroore ngam halki defte log fuu.
Ɗu'um huutoreeji ɗon haani yahugo yimɓe. Wurooji, nder duniyaaru fuu, kawtal, e jeewte je'eteeɗi ɗi ciya waawi fuɗɗugo ɓaawo kuuɗe boo. Tabitino jaɓɓorgo nder deftere juulde nden e hawtingol.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Maɓɓitol Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager ngam profaili je ɗon mari wallugo. Synix ɗon andina kujeji je ɗum wurtini e jaɓɓorɗe je ɗum jaɓata; nde wala deftere je ɗon mari kala mod.
wurtinugo paket je galle 1. Duniyaaji, add-ons je ɗon woodi, e jaɓɓorgo je ɗon hawta. 2. Saki server nder Synix e ɗon duroo ngam kuddol kuuɗe maako yaaki. 3. Yi'a sistem add-on ngal yi'i, nokkuure haɓɓugo, e nder limtinol jammu. 4. Suɓugo Install From File ko Import Package ngam fayil, ZIP, mala taskaram mod timmi. Jaɓɓorgo Kewuuji ngenndi Daande Baɗowal 5. Ndaaree nokkuure nde ɓe njahi, jaɓɓorgo, hokkugo anndal, e tabbitinol. 6. To'o haɓɓugo, jaɓɓaago, e haɓɓugo timmoode. 7. Synix ɗon ɓeyda listugo to ɗum timmini. Fuu fuɗɗoroo to haani, nden ndaaruki kuutoragol ciya e hawtaade maccuɗo.
List ɗon holla nokkuure haɓɓugo. Kuutoro Suudu ngam yi'ugo add-on bee innde, type, source, malla laawol. Fuuɗugo suɓaaji ɗi'i boo ɗon hokkata kuuje ɗe suɓaama to ɗum ɗon haani. Ɗuum laaɓtugol hollirta feere-feere ɓeydaaki.
Hokka tagirol maɓɓitunde nder wakkati scan ko waylitol. Synix ɗon halla kuuɗe je ɗon hawta bana ɗe timmi. To kuugal gootol footi, janngi kuugal ngal e ɓeyda limgal ngol ngam ɗaɓɓitaago boo.
LAMBE WORKFLOW Kuɗol golle hawti e Minecraft JAR packages, Rust Oxide/uMod plugins, local 7 Days to Die pakkeeji, Empyrion scenarios e server mods, ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop IDs, e ARK: Survival Ascended provider IDs. Ɗe sistemji feere ɗon huutore tan, malla ɓe ɗon ɗaɓɓita dabare maɓɓe arande.
Ngam ID's provider, Synix ɗon jaɓɓa tagdi ɗi ɗon walli ngam gamol/provider ɗon hokkata ko haani. Ɗuum ɓeydi naftirtaaki yahugo haa jooni waawataa yahugo ha nokku.
KINKINKINKINKINKINKINKINKIN KINKINKINKINKIN Yimɓe importirɓe ɗon ɗaɓɓita laaɓnde pakkeeji e nokkuuje ɓe njaɓa, ɓe ɗon jaɓa laawolji ɗi mbaawaa tabbitugo, haadeji, ɗi ɓe njaɓaay waɗugo, pakkeji ɓurɗi ɗuuɗugo, nokkuuje ɗe ɓe duplicata, be anndal malware.
Skanngo Defender je ɗon haani yahugo ko habaru, naa hollaago malware. Ɗuɓɓugo laaɓtugol e haasji huutoreeɗi boo hollataa pakke go'o tabbitinaama. Mods huwtata bee Windows hakkilooji server.
CALLOGES, HINNAANDE, E FULNugol Browse Catalog wayliti website provider. Ɗu'um ɗon halla ko'e addictionji masin, malla hawrugo modpack mawngo.
Saki server'en yeeso wurtinki import. Ɗu'um ɗon wurtina importam fuɗnaama, ngam waawataa hawtaago bee add-ons ɗuuɗɗi. Ɗu'um ɗon hokkata fuɗɗaaji je ɗon hoolaago e haɓɓugo faylje je ɗon hoolugo. Fuuɗuki importirɗe kesam fuɗɗam to ɗi mbaɗata fayl; Synix ɗon haɓɓa hawrugo faylji je ɗon waylitina feere to ɗum wurtina ko ɗum wurtina koo huutore asli je ɗon wurtina hakkilantaaku maɓɓe je wurtina. Deftere importare ɓurii na waawaa hawtaade hashes for saved originals.
Ngam ID mo jaɓɓortoowo jaɓɓorgo, Remove Selected jaɓɓortoo ID man diga haɓɓondiral jaɓɓorgo Synix; ɗum naa' falnde ko'e nokku. Synix wurtina waylital ngal o waɗata, naa hawritaaku go'o. Hokka tagdi server fulɓe fuu: jaɓɓugo mod ina waawi waɗugo duniyaaru warataake walla jaɓɓugo mod-jo'o.
Ɗuum tagdi fuɗɗitol holli walaa add-onji ɗi ɓeydooɗi ɗo hawti e nokkuure jaɓɓorgo e ɗaɓɓaade. Fuuɓugo ɗaɓɓitaare e jaɓɓorgo profile, folder, e framework yeeso wiɗugo fayluuji fuu dow disk ɓe ɗaɓɓiti.

data.value:
Open Add Server → Catalogue support for game to check what Synix o anndi dow ciya ka'e yeeso o tagi ko o wurtata. Catalogol huutoroo defte je ɗon hawta bee kuɗol ma.
1. Ɗaɓɓita ko innde juulde. 2. E huutoree filtarji haɓɓitol, player-data, crossplay, compatibility, ko verification ngam ɓeydude limtal ngal. 3. Taƴa ko'e ngondi e maɓɓitugo ko'e maako, koo boo ɗiɗaɓɓi ɗemngal dow laamiiji maako. 4. Mbele jaŋde jaŋde supporting, server-program, prerequisite, e verification info.
Wurtinugo filtirji to fijirde man ɗon wala. Minecraft's Java be Bedrock suɓaaji ɗon nder kuugal setup man ko ɓuri sistemji modji ɗiɗi je ɗum footi waylita.
Janngin ko'e mon bee hakkiilo Profil waawata hokkugo jaɓɓorgal jaɓɓorgo, jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo, jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo, malla jaɓɓorgo saɗi/maŋki. Ɗu'um je'eteeɗo fulfulde walla Steam AppID hollirta no huutore huutoraade; ɗum tawataay ko'e fijirde ciya fuu.
Ɗuum ko noddaade SteamCMD, ɗum firti tagdi ƴellitol jaɓɓorgo account. Yimɓe jogiiɓe juulde e sariyaaji publisher'en mbaawata waɗugo ko ɓeydooji.
DEFOULT PORTS HAKKINDE FIREWALL Limngal taskaram ƴamol je ɗon tabita naa ɗum tabbitinan yo'o jaɓoowo ƴamol ɗon woodi malla yo'o haani wurtineeki. Naftirgo dabareji fijirle be dookaaji je goonga.
Catalogue woni nokku ngam yi'ugo baylitol ngal. Deftere huutoreeji nokkuuje holli ko yi'ii nder PC ɗo, naa footi footi ngam masinji malla modji fuu.

HINNAANDE DUNGAANDE DUNGAANDE Synix waawata anndugo kuugal server je ɗon hawtina e warugo jogorgal maɓɓe. Hokka huutore fuɗɗorɗe ngam timmugo yeeso fuɗugo haala go'oto.

Kuugal je ɗon haani hujja Synix je ɗon haani, kuugal Windows je ɗon haani, e PC je ɗon haani. Wonduki nder fuɗugo naa' ɗum alkawal ngam kuugal waɗata wakkati masin ɗon maaki.
KAARO WINDOOJJI WINDOO Caggal ko'e cembiɗol, ko'e jaɓɓorgo e ko'e jaɓɓorgo. Saki juulde nder Synix ngam ɓe mbaawata rokkude bana boɗɗum, nden njehi malla fuɗɗii Windows.
Ndaa tammude konsole ciya ɓoyma ɗon jooɗoto, koo boo to maɓɓata tagaaje njanngooji ɗon maɓɓita kuugal. Ndaa dow dashboard nden naftora kuugal jaɓugo nguurndam nguurndam.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Fuli ko'e server je ɓe cuɓii ngam huutore ko haani. Wakkati fuɗugo hawti e Synix hawtaaki dow dookaaji feere-feere.
DLL MESSING DLL MESSAGES Kuje dow MSVCP140.dll malla VCRUNTIME140.dll fuɗɗii hollaago ko hawti e Visual C++ runtime. E huutoree ko jokkondirtee e jokkondirtee e Microsoft.
Winndannde caggalMicrosoft's redistributable information: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Ɗaɓɓitaaki fayl DLL feere-feere diga siteeji random koo darnugo DLL'en naa dow server executable.
Kuje goɗɗe Ciwgal waawaa warugo account, hakkilo server, sahaa Java feere-feere, feature Windows, malla hardware gootol. Fulfulde ko'e kuuje ɗe arande fuɗɗoraaki waylude ko'e dammugal walla resetting configuration.
Ngam Minecraft Java, huutoro ko hawti e version/loader combination diga Synix's selectors. Bedrock naftiraaki Java.
Ngam huɓɓugo haani Hyper-V malla hardware virtualization, tawtoree kuutorgol jaɓɓorgo haani. Taa hokkugo kuuɗe nder sistem'en, malla huuwugo ko'e server'en bana ardiiɗo ngam foofugo habaru.
Caggal nde tawtoreede ko haani, fuɗɗitaaki feere feere nden wi'a footi arande footi nder game-log to o ɓeydi footi.

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Eertina deftere nden to LAN play huwti, amma to test-address-public du.
Kuɓol haɓɓugo yimɓe Woɓɓe router'en hawtaaki NAT loopback, biyeteeɗo hairpinning. Wondiral diga nder wuro to address ummaatoore mum waawataa majjugo, koo nde yimɓe fuɗɗaaɓe mbaawa hawtaade.
Ɗuuruki address LAN nder saare e ƴamugo goɗɗo nder internet feere ngam lartugo address ummaatoore. Wonde WAN nder PC ma'anaaki wondi daliila warugo internet.
LAMBINDE WALLAAKOWANDO WALLAAKOWANDO Ndaaree ngam router feere dow, double NAT, malla carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT). Wonndi anndal WAN router'en bee address ummaatoore nden ƴami ISP to hawtaago hawtaama.
Sariya darnugo nder router'en on waawataa udduki NAT mo ISP hawtori dow. Haa dow hawtaade, ɗum waawi warugo jaɓɓorgo ummaatoore, VPN/tunnel haani, malla server haani. Ɗi'e ɗon haɓɓugo bana fuɗɗi, naa ɗi ɗon haɓɓugo bana Synix.
Taa hawta jamirooje bee accesi gamer Wondiral fannu-control e wondiral gamer ngal ko laawol gootol. Haɓɓugo nokku API walla Discord huutoreeji naa waɗata fijirde fooyre e nder internet.
Hokka ko'e teskaaji networka go'o haɓɓii to port e protocol asli ciya. Taa wurtina ɓaleeɓe, tagdi, fotooji router'en, malla kubaruuji sarɗi feere-feere to on ɗaɓɓi wallude.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Ɗuuruki logol ngal woni nder kuugal ngal footi.
Kuugal SYNIX Activity & Diagnostics ɗon holla ɓamtaare e habaruji je ɗon nafata huutortooɓe dow dashboard. Ɗuɓɓugo nokkuure nde'e ɗon laaɓina tan bolle ɗe yi'eteeɓe; ɗum taƴataa jaayndeeji njamndi fuu.
LOGES haɓɓugol Synix logs text be fatal-crash reports be normally under: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Ɗuɗal tagdi waawata nodda fayl gootol. Yiita laawol ngol e sahaa nde footi heɓugo jaɓɓorgal ngal.
Ɗu'um haalaaji nyauɓe mbaawaa windi nder deftere mawɗo, ammaa ɗi ngalaa dow dashboard. Fuuɗuki huutoreeɗum nder go'o naa' ɗum holli dow daliila ɓesdaaki dabare.
GAME LOGS Eertina log game asli server haɓɓaaɗo ngam kaɓirol duniyaaru, haɓɓirol, mod, e jokkondiral sahaa. Ɗuum nokkuure ɗon duumi dow ciya nden waawataa wonugo yaasi fuɗnaago.
KANDE nder haala Yi'a kuuɗe nden e wakkati, nden yi'a bolle haandi dow majjum fuɗɗam. Linenji ɓooyɗi haa fuɗɗam waawi wonde sakkitiiɗum, naa daliila.
Kaŋko ɓeydaaki ko'e feewde, ƴeew password, tokens, webhooks, addressji goɗɗi, e laawol goɗɗum. Satisfactory'console / log hoore mum ina waawi hawtaade token mawɗo. Hokka defte asli ngam ɗaɓɓitaare maaɗa.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Furi waawde jeytaade hawrugo ko nder server feerootiri. Suɓo server ngal haani e hokka ko ɓooyi yeeso.
1. Saki server nden waɗuki go'o ko'e jaaynde faylji ɗi a yiɗi. 2. Haɓɓu kuutorgol golle ceerno nder Sarɗiiji Server. 3. Taƴo arkifugo ko haani e wiɗugo server maako, sahaa, mawnuki, e ɓesngu mum. 4. Tabitin ɗum yeeso warugo. Synix backups be SHA-256 receipts waawi waawde tawtoreede bee receipts ɗii; ardiiji ɓurii waawaa anndiraade bana ardiiji. 5. Janngina habaru jaɓɓorgo nden tabbitin tan to ɗum woni nokku je ngaɗataa. 6. Hokka darnde e warugo timmoode fuɗɗoraaki ɓorugo Synix koo dammugo gardagol. 7. Fuli server nden tabitini wonde duniyaaru e jaɓɓorgo je ɗon yiɗi hawriti.
KINNAAKO WONNAAKO WONNAA Kuɗol kalluɗum ɗon sendina waylaaku ha dow receipt. Ɗum hollataay wonde aduna go'o haawnii nde o hisni ɗum, koo boo wonde defte ɗe goɗɗo feere jogii ko goonga.
To WONDE WONDIRO DUNNiraa Hokka arkif e fayluuji go'o je'eteeɗi. Janngii habaruuji warugo yeeso ɗaɓɓugo warugo ko'e fayl feere.
Taa wurtina ZIP dow serwer je ɗon maaro. To juulde ɗon hokka jaayɗe yaaki nder foldere hoɗondiral, warugo ɗe feere bee kuugal juulde ɗon wallita.
Hokka tagdi asli haa on foonditii serwer ngal e darnde maccuɗo.

data.value:
Import Existing Server ɗon jaɓɓina darnde ɗon ɗon ɗon haandi dow disk. Ɗu'um walaa reinstall e feere to importing a complete Synix transfer package.
Kaŋko on wurtina Waɗugo backup feere, hawti bee ko'e kuɓaaji fuɗɗiiɗi nder folder haɓɓuki. Saki server e hallude mooliiɗo feere ko waawata fuɗɗugo ɗum wakkati Synix ɗon jaɓɓa ɗum.
RIGHTER INSTALLATION 1. Taƴi add server → import server ɗon. 2. Taɓɓi foodaaji jontaaji server, naa foodaaji, fayl ZIP, malla foodaaji game-client. 3. Hokka Synix yi'a ɗum, nden hokkuki tabbitinol fijirde huutoraade, edition, executable, e settings. 4. Hokka tagdi innde feere-feere nden fulina ko'e ko'e maaki. 5. Caggal import, maɓɓita Configure, e wiɗugo laawol e portol. 6. Fulɓina ɗon, nden waɗugo fuɗɗol go'o. Ndaa to duniyaaru e foondirde nde yiɗi haɓɓii.
KINNAANDE KUMAAL Jaɓɓorgo naftirtaako jaɓɓorgo, naftirtaago jaɓɓorgo, koo jeytaago fayluuji jaɓɓorgo. Ɗuum ɓaawo kuuɗe ɗe a suɓii, bana Update, Validate, ko warugo configuration, waawata wayla fayl.
Wurooji fuɗɗam, modpacks, passwords, e dammugal jaɓɓorgo footi waawataa yi'ugo masin. Ɗuum laawol hawrugol waawataa huutoreede ɗiɗawre.
HIN DETECTION FAILS Ndaa ko a suɓii hawrugol server yahugo ngam jaɓɓorgo tagdiyankoore. Taa fuɗɗoro innde waɗugo ko hawtaaki ngam huwtoreede. Wurtina ko'e ngonka e deftere foodaaɓe ngam ɗum waawata tabbitinde.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
E huutoroo e deftere nde tawtoreeɗo configuration wi'i nokku ɗo jaɓɓorgo, mawngol ngol, walla tawtoreede template.
FAAMNDE KO'O FIRTINDI • Duuɗal jaɓɓorgo ngam ɓeydaago ko'e maɓɓaaki nder taariiɗe je ɓe cuɓiri. • Repair solves a reported supported problem. • Reset warata default template'en e waawi woɗɗitaade darnde.
Reset naa' ko fuɗɗoode ngam majjugo server fuu. Sahaaji juulde ɓooyɗi, portji hawtaade, e modji ɓillaaɗi ɗi mbaawataa laaɓugo ngam tuugugo faylji tagdi.
Kaŋko ɓe njogii Caggal ciya, acca ko'e fayluuji ɗi ɗon hawta, nden jaŋge ceede ɓernde. Fewte profile'en ina woodi template'en keewuɗi; woɓɓe ɗon tammi juulde ngam waɗugo fayl ha fuɗugo fuɗugo ko'e maɓɓugo masin.
Synix ɗon anndina tagji ɗi haani, ammaa ɗon ta'a waawde darnde fuu. Ngam huutoreeje modification module laatiiɗo, ɗum waawi hokkaade go'o koppi biyeteeɗo .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
Caggal nde ɓe mbaɗti ceede walla ɓe cuɓii Hokka fayl tagdi ko'e warugo e nanugo habaruuji warugo. Wondiruki ko fuɗɗii e ko waylitiri yeeso to a suɓii ko hawrata. Taa maɓɓita dowlaaji tawtoreeki reset.
Caggal warugo, fuɗɗii go'o e ɗaɓɓitaade nder kuugal ngal. Hakkilani wonde o ɗon jaŋda laawol ngol haani e wonde ko haani haani ɗon haa jooni.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune huutoroo laabi jaɓɓorgo ɓoyre bee masinji virtuol je'e e warugo konu. Ɗo'o naa' server juulde gootol.
FULJINGOoje Janngina Synix's checks of readiness for system memory, AVX2, hardware virtualization, Hyper-V, e jaaynde Windows mawɗo. Kuugal ɓerɗe nder hakkilantaaki e karallaaji ɗi ngaɗata.
Synix ɗon waawataa waɗugo virtualisation malla rakkude Hyper-V. Caggal nde ɓe njogii, ɓe keewi ko haani waɗugo.
INSTALL e INITIALIZE 1. Wondira ko Dune: Awakening hawrata e wiɗugo ko hawrataa e foodaaji. 2. Jaɓɓorgo e fuɗɗora ɗum. 3. Synix fuɗɗitoto kuugal battlegroup.bat ngal official tool bee jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo ngam jaɓɓorgo ngol. 4. Suɓaa initial-setup nder kuugal fijirde nden hokku token hooreejo ma. 5. Fuuɗugo VM, network, e warngooɓe warngo nder kuutorgal ngal.
Jaɓɓorgo Token Self-Host to portal dowla Funcom ngam huutoraade laawol jaɓɓorgo/nganndi: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Hokka tagdi go'o. Ɓeynguure for this deployment tool means not every Synix server should run as administrator.
LINJIILAANDE NESTAAKE E KONTROL E huutoroo huutoreeji host/VM network's actual layout and required ports. Metadata fannu wiɗto nder Synix ɗon wakkilana RMQ, naa nanngoowo wiɗto A2S.
Windoojo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo maral ngal hollataa wonde VM'en mum'en ngoppitii. Tabitin haala huwtoreeɓe e waɗugo kuugal kawrol konu bee kuugal jaɓɓorgo nder kuugal.
Synix waawi rakkude, ɓeydaade, fuɗɗorugo, e jaɓɓorgo fayde rakkude nde suɓaama. Ndaa tammugo timmoode laaɓnde, ƴamɗe player'en, malla warugo doggo watchdog ɗon jejjita ɓesngu. Jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo fayl naa' ɗum hokkata ngam ɗemngal ngal.
E huutoroo e laabi tagdi ngam ɓeydaade VM/database data. ZIP-folder deployment be hoore ma'a naa'de backup tabbitinki ɗon.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Ɗuum ɗemngal woni ngam ɓeydaani'en e wallitooɓe. On hewtanay huutorooje ɓamtaare ngam waɗugo server diga profile gootol.
HOW DEFINITIONS WORK Winndannde caggalWolduɗe ɓesngu ɗi ɓe mbinndinta dow downloads, executables, Steam AppIDs e noddugo login, ardiiji fuɗnaaki, ports, jokkondiral configuration, prerequisites, e darnde controller.
Defte suɓii jokkondirɗe nder nder nder. Ɓe mbaɗataa ɗemngal ɓamɗe ngam huutoreeɓe, mooɓondirɗe, koo ɗemɗe jaɓɓorɗe. Fuuɗugo fayl JSON nder deftere ñaawirgal daartol wurtataa ɓesngu jaaynde juulde.
COORRECT OR ADD A PROFILE 1. Fuɗɗugo bee huutoreeji server haɓɓooɓe e fayluuji haɓɓooji asli. 2. E huutoree laawol gootol server-root, to haani, e hollirde ko'e fijirde e fijirde. 3. Wondirtee templateji gootol e nder nokkuuje maɓɓe je ɗon hawrugo. 4. Jaɓɓorgo Deftere/Configuration/Template. 5. Wurtina deftere, maaki bee SDK haani ngam kuɗol, e waɗugo lartol je ɗon haani. 6. Njaafol lartol, fuɗɗugo, darnugo, be aynol be fijirde goonga hiddeko wurtinugo tabbitinol.
Defte Builder ko masin ngam ɓamtaare, naa haɓɓitol foonditaaki.
FULNDE FULNDE • UI: Feature windows. • ServerHandler: game controllers e server integers. • SynixEngine: Safaaku nguurndam app, jaɓɓorgo, networking, backups, e jam. • Ɗuɓɓuki: Ɗuɓɓuki kuugal, ɗemɗe, e wallitooɓe kuugal. • Database/GameDefinitions: Profiils game e templates. • Database/ModSystems: Kuugal add-on hawtaama. • Localisation: Interface catalogues e generators. • Fuuɗuki: Fuuɗuki foondooji.
Ngam baylitol, ɓeyda ko'e ɗemɗe fuu bee habaru e jaɓɓorgo nokkuuje. Wondira be kubaruuji wallude, nyauɓe, kubaruuji jaɓɓorgo, e baylitol huutoreeji. Ɗaɓɓitaaki umrooje, keyji, tokenji, ko'e huutorooɓe, ko'e markaaji anndaago output. Deftere nyau ndu fuɗɗii ɓeydaaki.
Janngi License & Proprietary Terms ko ɓeydi hokkugo code ko maɓɓata. Hokka dabareeji goɗɗi e defte goɗɗe nder kuugal e kuugal.

Haɓɓitaade kalkal njamɗingol server tan caggal nde on ɗaɓɓaani jokkondirɗum backup, update, stop, e start.
1. Handeeje automation/schedule'en maɓɓiti nden hokkuki kalkal. 2. Suɓi nyalɗe e wakkati. 3. Hokka Smart Maintenance e suɓugo jaɓɓorgo backup / update. 4. Taƴa ko haani waɗugo suɓaaɓe ɓe'e e taƴa ɓeydaare ɓurnde. 5. Hokka e lartol nder karallaagal jaɓɓorgo nde a waawi huuwugo.
Kalluuji naftira bee wakkati PC'en. Hokka saa'i maajum e sahaa maako gooŋga.
To Wuro Duuɓuɗo Synix waawaa hoolaade ngam jokkondirɓe hawtaade, ɓaawo ɗon o waawata darnugo goomu kuutorgol tabbitinol, waɗugo backup wakkati daartol, ɓesdaago, e fuɗɗugo bana ko haani.
Jaɓɓorgo Kewuuji feere-feere, naa alkawal jaɓɓugo haa abadaa. Jaɓɓol footi fuɗɗama to ndu timmi bo'o to fijooɓe ɗon. Jaangirde je wala jaangirde hokkata wala wakkatiiji jaɓɓol.
FIIRAANGAL LONGOOWOOJO O DOLI Wakkati ɗon duumi dow anndal juulirde laatoo. An API- hawtaade Satisfactory server ɗon haɓɓii limgal ɓeydaaki malla yahugo nder wakkati duumiiji. Ɗu'um ɗon waɗa kuutoreeje jaɓɓorgo ɗe ngaɗataa jaɓɓorgo tabbitinol.
Wondirɓe ɓesngu yeeso e nanugo kubaruuji kuugal ngal. Discord habaruji waawi warugo kuuje wartirɗe ɗi ɗon walli to laawol maɓɓe hawrata.
PC's gotta be awake and the relevant Synix process or background agent gotta be running. Komputaar go'o ɗon maaki malla ɗon ɗaana waawataa waɗugo jaɓɓorgo e fuɗɗorgo ordinateer.

Fuli Windows Terminal ko PowerShell nden huutoro tagdi pakke ɗon dow. Ɗee umrooje ɗon jaɓɓa Synix hoore mum, naa server'en ciya feere-feere.
INSTALL winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
FIIRA BAAKKA JANGO O WONDI winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
WANDE Ɓamtaare Saki Synix nden timmina kuugal maɓɓol yeeso huutore: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
DUNINSTALL LAPPLICATION winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Hokka ko'e mon Server installation, saving, e backups ɗon tawaa diga package application. To on yiɗataa yaajugo C:\Synix malla ko'e foodaaji data je ɗon haani yaajugo.
To umroore ɗon moofta Njaŋge daliila ko ɗum wi'i. To WinGet ɗon wi'a wonde hash moftal ngal hawtaayi, jooɗa e wi'a ɗum; jaɓɓaaki tabbitinol hash. Jaɓɓorgal je majji footi maani yo'o repository wurtinaayi paket je kesi haa jooni.
Jaɓɓorgo WinGet e haash jaɓɓorgo ɓooyngol ɗon taƴaaki code-signing Synix koo tabitugo so software jammu Windows laatoto hoolaaki.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Ko fuɗɗii hollude wonde juulde ɗon huutore nder network maaɗa. Ceerno router waawataa haɓɓugo fijirde nde fuɗɗitake ko timmini.
Yiɗee Demmugal Fooyre • Ha PC server: huutoro jokkondiral gootol ko hawti e jokkondiral. • Nder masin masin masin: naftoro address LAN server PC'en. • Fuɗɗam nder network wuro maaɗa: naftoro address ummaatoore ma'en maa laawol heɓugo / hawtaade nder ciya.
Fedde ƴeewtagol haɓɓondiral ngam jaɓɓorgo ɓesngu nde ɓe cuɓii ngam yi'ugo dabareeji mum. Adirese LAN go'o waawataa huutoreede to internet players.
TEST LOCALLY 1. Ngaree haa juulde timmi. 2. Jaɓɓorgo fayde port e server's Readyness results. 3. Wondira diga PC host, nden daga masin masin LAN. 4. To jaɓɓorgo LAN footi, ndaaruki log game e jaɓɓorgo Firewall Windows ngam jaɓɓorgo server fulfulde.
MAHFAN Duduɓe Internet 1. Hokka host address LAN tabbitol, fuɗɗam e router DHCP reservation. 2. Hinnda portol ko haani e protocolol TCP/UDP for the actual game configuration. 3. Ɗaɓɓitinol ɗi'e tan to address LAN host'en. 4. Hokka ko jokkondirtee e jokkondirtee e Windows Firewall nder ɗemɗe network ɗe huutore. 5. Fuuɗuki diga hawtaade internet feere.
Taa hokke router DMZ, halla firewall, koo holla dow kala port laamorde bana laaɓal. Hokka ko'e kubaruuji router goɗɗum.
Synix woni mawɗo desktop local. Ɗum hawtaay dabareeji jaayndeeji e nder internet, koo haalde ummaatoore ngam waɗugo ko hawti e ɗeen dookaaji network.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD jaɓɓortooji e ɓeydaaki fayluuji serɓooɓe ngam juulde Steam. Synix ɗon haɓɓita ko'e maako ɗi ɓe mbaɗata bee hoore mum; jaɓɓorgo server ordinare warataako tab SteamCMD feere.
TAWƊO KUMAAL Taƴi server e jaŋde Activity & Diagnostics. Kuugal tagdi ɗon holla kuugal saɗugo ɗon waɗa. SteamCMD waawata yahde hakkunde jaɓɓugo, yahugo, jaɓɓugo, e jaɓɓugo, ngam non yahugo maako ɗon hokkataa ɗuuɗal tagdi malla wakkati tabbitol.
Hokka golle diski ngam timmina ko nde nder network traffic ɓadake. Kaŋko jaŋde ko'e foofugo ko'e foofugo ko'e foofugo ko'e fuɗugo.
Limite Download Speed Open Settings → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Taɓo laawol limtinol ngol hawtaama e taƴo ɗon hollata, malla taɓo bee humondiral fuu.
Ɗu'um ɗon hawta SteamCMD downloads, naa bandwidth gamers, non-Steam downloader kala game, malla fuu traffic dow PC.
SIN-IN e FAILURES Fewte game profiles yiɗi aadi Steam account e Steam Guard tabbitinol. huutoroo ko Synix's sign-in prompt; haɓɓitaade kuutoreeji jaayndeeji e nder defte walla jaayndeeji.
Ngam jaɓɓorgo footi, janngina footi SteamCMD e jaɓɓorgo laabi disk, jaɓɓorgo folder, jaɓɓorgo network, e ko haani dow account. Jaɓɓorgo Jaɓɓorgo Kewuuji ngenndi ina waawi ɓeyda jaɓɓorgo faylji ɗi jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo, ngam non njogii waylude jaɓɓorgo yeeso huutoreede.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Empyrion scenarios e server-code mods ɗon feere. Nder Servers Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, suɓi Empyrion scenarios ko Empyrion servers mods. Saki server nden waɗa backup server fulfulde yeeso waɗugo baylitol.
INSTALL A SCENARIO 1. Browse Catalog ouvents Steam Workshop. Ɗaɓɓo haala nden nden ɗonno haa Steam timmini jaɓɓorgo maako. Ɗuɓɓudi e ko'e kuɓirɗe nder kuugal duɗal naa'ji haala server. 2. Taƴo taƴo taƴo taƴo taƴo taƴo Taɓo foodaaji haala go'oto nder foodaaji Steam library's steamapps\workshop\content\383120. A waawi suɓugo haala ZIP fuu. 3. Taƴa innde foodaaji haalaji anndaande. Ɗo'o huutoree tan ID Workshop numeric. Hokka nden innde fooda ngam ɓeydaago ɓaawo. 4. Jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo e jaɓɓorgo daartol, caggal ɗum jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo. Synix tawtori haala fuu haa Content\Scenarios to walaa ko hawtata ɗum koo waylude duniyaaru. 5. Taƴi Scenario lists installed scenarios. Taƴi go'o e taƴi innde jaɓɓorgo feere. Jaɓɓorgo Fedde Ɓamtaare Fedde Ɓamtaare Synix ɗon holla go'o e ɗon acca kuuje ɗon ɗon ɗon. 6. Waɗugo suɓugo, fuɗɗita server, e ɗaɓɓita log maako e hawtaade maccuɗo. Fewte scenariiji ɗon woodi tagdi feere-feere ko mawɗo maɓɓe hujja.
Scenario innde ɗum GameConfig.CustomScenario; innde-dunyaaji kisndiraaɗi woni GameConfig.GameName. Synix ɗon jaɓɓa dedicated.yaml ngam waylude fannuuji ɗi'i, nden o ɗon hokkito tagdi server. Ɗu'um du'a reset seed, passwords, ko hawtaaki e goɗɗum.
INSTALL SERVER MODS E huutoro mods server Empyrion profile e Import Package ngam suɓugo mod ZIP ko haɓɓii koo mod fulfulde. Hokka DLL's, jaɓɓorgo jawdi, dependences, e _Info.yaml to ɗum hokkata. Synix ɗon wurtina ɗi nder Content\Mods; game loads code nde fuɗɗi. Downloads source-code e installers goɗɗuɓe naa support pakkeji.
Synix don't install a mod loader or enable a disabled mod automatically. Tokku do'aaji mawɗo man, hauti be loaderji feere-feere, dabareji, be darnugo client. Jaɓɓorgo Jaɓɓorgo Daande Baɗowal
FULNDE E FULNDE Steam ɗon ɓeyda boɗeeji maɓɓe, naa bo boɗeeji server ɗi Synix ɗon importira. Ngam ɓeydaade, halki server e importugo pakke ɓeydaama huutoroowo innde foldere foondo. Ndaa to mawɗo yiɗi jaɓugo feere. Fiilooji je ɗon jeyaa ɗon jaɓa koode ɓaawoje; importing a update is not a clean reinstall and does not delete files missing from the new package.
Fuuɗugo listji pakkeje fuu ɓurɗe fahin ngam daliila go'o. Ɗu'um ɗon haɓɓii (taaki ɗiɗaɓɓi) ma'ana import ngol haɓɓii, naa' ngam fayl fuu ɗon haɓɓii ɗon haɓɓii. Roll Back Import ɗon wurtina jaɓɓorgal jaɓɓorgo fuu, hawti bee mods feere nder pakke go'o, e ɗon haɓɓa ngam suɓugo faylji je ɗon wayla Synix. Scenario'en je ɓe cuɓii e asyano'en je ɓe haani ngam duniyaaruje je ɓe kuɓɓi ɗon njogitaaki diga jaɓɓugo; jaɓɓorgo laabi ɗi ɗum wurtina ɗon waawi warugo to defte ɓooyɗe.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Open Configure → Network & RCON ngam yi'ugo endpointsji ɗi juulde je suɓaama. Ɗuuruki haɓɓirgol fijirde nden, naa nder limtinirgol portuuji.
PORT ROLES • Game port: traffic player. • Port ƴellitaare: baylitol server walla heɓugo, to ɗum hawti e ƴellitol ƴellitaare. • RCON/admin port: Kanal jaɓɓorgo dow laabi. • App/API port: Goomu jokkondirgo koo goomu jaɓɓorgo.
TCP e UDP ko protocolji feere-feere. Ɗi ɗiɗo protocolji feere-feere ina mbaawi huutoreede limngal port gootol, amma serverji ɗiɗo mbaawataa feerootirgo e nanondiral nanondiral. Synix ɗon ɗaɓɓita profiles je ɗon hoola ngam hawtaaki port, hawti e jaɓɓorgo.
Hokka endpoints hawteteeɓe feere-feere ngam misaaluji feere-feere e hakkilana jokkondiral hakkunde portji. Taa tammi gameplay fuu ko UDP koo to kala fannu wiɗtooji wakkilantaaɗo goonga.
LAMBI'EN BAAKKINGO HA WALDE Yimɓe jogiiɓe ɓe ngalaa haandi RCON koo dow ko'e go'o. Hokka jaɓɓorgo local to on ɗon woodi laabi jaɓɓorgo feere-feere.
Misaali'en FULNDE GAME • Minecraft Java e Bedrock huwti jokkondiral feere-feere; jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo nde suɓaama. • Satisfactory's local API huutoroo game/API port maako; ko'e ma'ajirɗe jaɓɓorgo dow ko'e ma'ajirɗe ngam Synix. • Dune's query-field metadata wakkilantaaki RMQ deployment port, naa Steam A2S service askuki. • Rust+ huutoroo endpoint go'o hawti e gameplay.
Default template'en woni fuɗɗooji fuɗɗooji, wonaa listol jaɓɓorgo router duniyaaru. Ndaaɗo nanngoowo goonga arande fuɗɗii waylude sariyaaji firewall.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: Dune: Awakening huutoroo sistem jaɓɓorgo server je ɗon haani. Hyper-V e hardware virtualization fotaama, nden Windows Pro ko Enterprise fotaama. Ha fuɗugo arande, Synix fuɗɗii battlegroup.bat bana Administrator. Taɓo initial-setup nden hokkugo tagdi hooreejo ma. Synix waawata rakkude, ɓeydaade, waɗugo backup, e fuɗɗugo huutoreede, ammaa juulde ɗon mari masinji viriwal'en e laamu maɓɓe. Jaɓɓorgo Dowla: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Discord webhooks nelda kuuje server feere to channel. Ɗi'e habaruji, naa bot Discord ngam huutore Synix diga to yaasi.
Hokka ko yiɗi waɗugo 1. Hokka ko haɓɓii e webhook ngam channel mo on mari hakkillaaji jaɓugo. 2. Open page Configure → Discord to server je ɓe cuɓii. 3. Hokka webhook nden suɓii ko haani waɗugo ko haani. 4. Jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo. 5. Ɗuuruki kuugal test to ɗum hokkata, malla tabituki hokkugo nder kuugal je ɗon haani.
Fuɗugo, shutdown, warugo, backup, e wartirgo habaruuji hawti dow laabi haani e ko huutoraade.
Hokka URL nden URL webhook ɗon hawti e karallaagal posting. Koo moye keɓɗo ɗum waawaa wurtina bolle to laawol ngol. Toɗɗina ɗum nder fotooji, suɓaaji, ɗemɗe, e haalaaji.
Synix ɗon hakkilana webhookji maako je ɗon haandi ngam huutore Windows. To URL'en ɗon holla, wurtina ɗum nder Discord, nden ɓeyda to Synix. Yiila ko innde server'en e kubaruuji kuɗol ngol sendinaama to channel gootol.
So Wurooji Ɗe Ɗe Ndaa Wuroo Ndaa laawol kuɗol ngol suɓaama, URL, yahugo channel/webhook, e to PC ina waawi heɓugo Discord. Yiya ko'e fijirde huutoreeji ɗi annditi, to a wurtinaay URL fuu.
Huutoreeji huutoree hawtaade to Discord. Ɗu'um haani haɓɓugo portol control router inbound.

Hokka C:\Synix, foodaaɓe server je ɗon haani, jaɓɓorgo juulde feere, e nokkuuje jaɓɓorgo to on yiɗi naftoraago ɗi boo. Ɗuɗɗugo ɗemngal ngal hawtaaki fuɗnaaki ɗi.

Ndaa huutoree tagdi bana waylude footi. Backup je ɗon hawrita tan nder folder je ɗon maɓɓa naa' ɗum kopiiji warugo.
To on ɗon yahda to boɗeeje feere, tabbitin ngam o waaway fuɗɗugo nastirde haani e ɓurnugo duniyaaru je ɗon yiɗi yeeso yaajugo data mawɗo.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Yiɗde server e huutoroo ko'e maɓɓe ngam teskaade jokkondirɗe maa player to ɗi ɗon woodi. Synix suɓii teskaade e dow ko'e nder kuugal ngal, TCP/UDP/HTTP, local API, e potal kuuɗe.
KINNAANDE Ɗuɗal ngal Jaabawol jokkondiral low level hollaayi wonde laawɗo waawata jaɓɓorgo e jokkondirgo. Ɗu'um je ɗon wondi boo hollaayi wonde kuugal ƴamol maako ɗon haani.
Yimɓe jeyaaɓe e innde ɓeen ko baawɗe goɗɗe. Server waawata anndugo no yimɓe ɗuuɗɓe je ɗon hawta bee maɓɓe, ammaa naa' ngam anndugo ko ɓe noddi. Kuulal gootol naa' ko haɓɓiiɗo limgal jokkondirɓe.
HIDDEN TOOLS OR N/A Fewte laabi EOS tan koo crossplay ɗi ɗon holla dow ƴaɓɓitol gootol walla laawol jaɓugo fijirloowo. Synix waawi hollaade N/A malla wurtina ɗaɓɓirde ngam hollaade jaaynde.
Ndaa edition feewde e channel jaɓɓorgo hawritaama ngam Minecraft. Satisfactory jokkere limti ɗon jeyi haɓɓuki API yahugo. Taa foondira eɓɓoore EOS ngam foonditaade lartol.
SERVER-BROWSER LISTINGS Yimɓe ɓooyɗe Steam ɗuuɗɓe naftira bee ƴamɗe A2S, ammaa ɗum naa' bana ko duniyaaru. Jaɓɓorgo, jaɓɓorgo juulde, e kuugal browser ɗon hawta yi'ugo, e walaa sahaa tagdi nder listing.
To server ɗon walaa nder browser, foondita laabi hawtuki toɓere nden nden e yi'ugo loggo maako. Ceertol portuuji ƴamɗe ɗe hawtaaka e maɓɓe no waawi waddugo caɗeele goɗɗe.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
E huutoroo Configure for the common fields Synix manages. E huutoreeɗo deftere jaayndeeki nder Server Options to a yiɗi yi'ugo ko haani jaayndeeki.
1. Saki server to o janngi fayl ha fuɗɗam ko o windi ɗum wakkati huutore. 2. Waɗde backup e tabbitinol server e fayl ɓe cuɓii. 3. Janngee ko'e jaaynde nden. 4. Ceertu tan ko tuugorɗe ɗe a yiɗi ceertude. 5. Wurtina hakkeeji jaayndiyankoore nden ɓe ndaara habaruji maako. 6. Jaɓɓorgo, fuɗɗora server bee Synix, e jaɓɓorgo ɓesngu diiwaan juulde.
FARMATAAJI TAWTIIɗi Synix ɗon hokkita jaɓɓorgo dow format ngam jaɓɓorgo INI/ji'aaku, JSON, XML, YAML, e formatji feere-feere. Walaa fayl ko'e fuu ko'e feere ɗon woodi jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo. Wartol YAML ɗon wallina settingsji nested, listji indented, be darnde line go'o ha wakati nde ɗon aynugo comments be indentation. Feereji YAML je sukli bana anchors, aliases, inline collections, be multiline values ɗon jaɓa bila wurtinugo.
Hokka keyji tagdi, ko jaɓaama, innde map, e umrooje bana no juulde ɗon tammi. Ndaa baylitugo ɗe ngam hawtaade e ɗemngal interface.
WALLAAKINGA WALLAAKINGO WALLAAKINGO WALLAAKINGO Fayl je ɗon haɓɓii e laaɓal footi hawtaade. Mods walla ɓeydaaki ciya waawi ɓeydaade laabi ɗi editor naa anndi. Ndaa ko fijirde ngal ɗacci fayl e aduna ɓaawo fuɗɗugo.
To tawritoowo feere malla fijirde wayliti fayl wakkati o haɓɓii, fuɗɗita maɓɓugo e nanondiral yeeso hisnugo. Fiilji game'en waawaa hawtaade passwords ko waawata jaɓde walla tokens; jaɓɓorgo maɓɓe e hawrugo ɓe yeeso hawrugo.
Satisfactory's live API fursatuuji hawti nder Control Center maako e ɓe tawaaɓe diga hawrugo faylji konfiguration dow disk.

data.value:
Taƴi taɓɓitaade ngam server woodi, malla huutoro tagdi setup wakkati tiggude go'oto. Ceerno tan fannuje je ɗon haani nder kuugal mon.
FULNDE E FULNDE FULNDE Fedde fuɗɗorɗo ɗon holla huutoreeje goɗɗe e ardiiji fuɗugo. Modu ɓeydi ɓeydi ɓeydi anndugo hakkillaaji farayse, hawti e RCON jaɓɓorgo e fursatuuji fuɗugo raw. Maɓɓugo modus ɗon halkake darajaji je ɗon hoola. Discord anndeeji ɗon haani nder laabi ɗiɗi fuu.
Ko Fedde Fedde Fedde Fedde Fedde Fedde • General: innde server, game, edition/version, e yiɗde gameplay-profile support. • Security: Passwords e goɗɗe setting access supported by template. • Yimɓe duniyaaru: innde duniyaaru, seed, mawnuki, e laabi duniyaaru. • Network & RCON: Firo gameplay, wiɗto, jokkondirɗo/API, e finngooji jaangooji. • Automation: Backup/update-on-start e maintenance scheduled. • Discord: Destination notification and event routing. • Install & Launch: folder installation e fursatuuji fuɗugo ɗon support.
Firooji ɗi ɓe mbaɗata ngam fijirde ɗi ɓe mbaɗata ngam fijirde ɗi ɓe mbaɗata. Yimɓe ina mbaawi jaɓde ɗum hoore mum walla ɓe mbaawaa jaɓde ɗum. hokki hujjaaji ɓeydiɗɗi nder dowla naa' ɗum dabare mum.
WONDE Kuje Foortol Baylitte server → Daartol ko haani → Review → Save server
Ɗi ɗon jaɓɓa jaɓɓorgal ɓamtaare, naa ɓamtaare jaɓɓorgo malla jaɓɓorgo. So tawii gollorɗe ko haani waɗii, Synix wayli step 3 ngam a waawi yi'ugo suɓaaji ma, nden o wurtini Save Server. Ceertol daartol ɓaleeɓe jaɓɓorgo Jaɓɓorgo Fooyre haa suɓaaji ɓeydiiɗi holli nder Review. On footi suɓugo hoore mooɗon; jaɓɓorgo Review ɗon mooftaay. Janngii ko woni nder fuɗɗoode nde huunde yiɗi jaɓɓorgo.
To tawtoreedi server, jooɗee ɗum arande to ceerno ngal hawti e fayluuji malla suɓaaji nanngeteeɗi ha fuɗɗorgal. Save Changes ɗon ɓeyda baylitol maako; ko hollataa wonde ko jokkondirtee ko waɗii e ɗeen dabi'en. Fuɗɗita nder Synix to ciya yiɗi ɗum.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Open Configure → Automation for the selected server to choose work that occurs before supported launches. Haɓɓii haɓɓitgol → Automatiki ngam serɓoowo boɗeeɗo ngam suɓugo kuugal ko waɗata yeeso fuɗɗorgal gootol.
BACKUP ON START Hokka ɗum ngam waɗugo backup server stop-server yeeso fuɗɗam huutore. Hokka tagdi tagdi tagdi e tagdi tagdi nder app Settings → Backups.
Caggal warugo ko'e maɓɓe fuɗɗii waɗugo no ɗum waɗirta. Backupji fuɗugo masin naa' ɓe ɗon jeyaa ngam haɓɓugo nokkuuji jaɓugo feere fuɗugo yeeso waylituki mawɗi.
Fedde Ɓamtaare Hokka ɗum ngam waɗugo jaɓɓorgo ɓesngu ɓesngu ɓesngu yeeso fuɗugo. Ɗum ɗon ɓeyda fayluuji server-gol ciya, naa app Synix.
Wonduki ɓeydaaki habaru naa' ko alkawal ngal fuɗɗam fuɗɗam jaɓɓorgo defte. SteamCMD e jaayndiyankeejo juulde'en taƴii ko haani.
WALDATION E CUSTOM FILES Ɗuum kuugal tabbitinol waawata warugo ko'e faylji ɗi jaɓɓortooɓe ɓesdaama. Ɓeydaade modification'en yeeso ɓeydagol ko haani; taa tammi faylji je ɗon je ɗon je ɗon marra.
Fuuɗini suɓaaji mon Jaɓɓorgo Daartol Firooji e waɗugo fuɗɗoode haalde. Janngee ko'e kuugal ngam jaɓugo, ɓeydaago, e fuɗugo. Ɗu'um ɓeydaama jaɓɓugo ɗum hollataa wonde juulde nden ɓeydaama.
Hokka nokkuure goɗɗum ngam ardiiji, downloads, faylji wakkatiire, e game haɓɓaaɗo. To kuugal fuɗɗorgal ɗon anndina huccuki, ɗaɓɓita daliila haalanki ngam fuɗugo server gootol to Synix ngam foofugo ɗum.

data.name: Content.CD4007BB408F0C6825C6
data.value: Open Documents\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg e set use g_console "1". Fuɗɗita fijirde American Truck Simulator jeewte, kawta ko'e mon e karallaagal maaku, press ~ ngam udduki console, nden wurtina export_server_packages. Saki ciya, nden klikke fuɗɗugo nder Synix. Synix waawata importugo faylji ɗi ɗum waɗi.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Haɓɓo Yaade ngam server je ɓe cuɓiri yeeso fuɗɗam maako malla to goɗɗum footi. Ɗu'um ɗon kawta ceekiji ɗi tagdi nder profil ngal, bana fiilooji, sahaaji kuugal, haandi, nokkuure disk, portji, haala kuugal, e logji je ɗon haani.
FAAMNDE Ɓaawoore • Haɓɓaa: Walaa daliila haɓɓaaji haɓɓaaɗi to checkji je woodi. • Fuuɗuki: Janngee ko heɓii nden taƴa ko haani waɗugo. • Bolluki: Hakkiilo hawtaare nde wi'etee yeeso.
Ɗu'um je ɗon haani waɗugo ko haani. Yiyaaki kuugal ngal haani e tabbitol ngol.
Caggal nde a heɓi tagdi keso Fuɗɗoode fuɗɗorgal ina waawi jaɓɓude faayiilaaji, huutoree sahaa huwtoreede, waɗugo daartol, e hoolaade fuɗɗitol fijirde. Ɗaɗol jaɓɓorgo fuɗɗam e Activity & Diagnostics ɓeydi hakkilantaago jaɓɓorgo dashboard je ɗon hoodi bana juulde je ɗon hawrata.
Yimɓe juulde ɓe ngaɗata haɓɓugo gootol, hakkilantaaku, koo nder juulde warugo/taƴondirde ngam goɗɗo waawde hawtaade. Caggal ngal dabare nder nokkuure nde juulde yiɗi.
FULNDE huutoreede Install, Start, Stop, and Monitoring sappinolji limta kujeji Synix laari. Wala tabbitinol yet ma'ana wala sappinol je limtaama; ndu ma'anaayi fijirde nden anndaama nde nyalaa.
Winndannde yeesoWolde Ready walla tabbitinol nokku fuɗnaaki ko garanteeji jaɓɓorgo internet, modji nyawɗi, koo hawtaade e maccuɗo kala. Fuuɗani ngam lartuki hawtaade e duniyaaru.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Backup-server feccere ɗon hokka fayl nder folder installation servers. Ndaaree to juulde ɗon hisna duniyaaru maako yeeso o ɗon hoola dow maajum.
Fuuɗugo go'o 1. Saki server nder Synix e ɗon duroo ngam kuuɗe maɓɓugo. 2. Taƴi kuuɗe backup nder Server Options. 3. Yiya fuɗɗoode, yahugo, mawnugo, e nokkuure dow diski. 4. Jaɓɓorgo Fulfulde e jaɓɓorgo Fulfulde. 5. Taƴa fayl " Open Backup Folder " ngam heɓugo arkif. Hokka ko'e maako ceede kalluɗum.
COVERAGE Backup ɗon hawta folder installation, naa subfolder cembiɗol tan. Ciwɗi mawɗi ina haani wakkati ɗuuɗugo e jaɓɓorgo.
Saves in AppData, Documents, drive feere, malla masin foortinal nder ciya waawi wonugo yaasi folder nden. Ɗuɓɓugo ɗi feere-feere huutoree laabi ciya.
LONGOOJI E CAKKINDE Root tagdi footi e C:\Synix\BackupGames. Settings → Backups laatake on suɓude root feere e waɗugo tonngoode tagdi footi.
Destination haani wonde yaasi folder server fuɗɗoode. Waylugo asngol ɓesdugo wala yahuki mala suddugo taskaramji ɗo mari; foondu nokkuure ndenno ngam dabareji ɓooyma.
Caggal nde ɗum haɓɓii ardiije ɓurɗe ɓeydaade to ɗum ɓeydaaki nder saɗtuki ardiije. Hokka nokkuuji warugo ngam permanent fuɗɗore nokkuure go'o.
Hokka go'o go'o jaayndeeji mawɗi nder nokkuure go'o. Deftere fuɗɗaaɗo waawde halki both server e defte go'o nder deftere go'o. ZIP nder deftere jaɓɓorgo fuɗɗoraaki naa'a automatically a consistent VM or database backup.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Kaŋko jaŋde Windows ko goonga, ngam a hoola ko o wayli. Ɗu'um ɗon waɗaa, kaɓirgol fayl, e ɓeydaade sahaa jokkondiral ɗum caɗeele feere feere.
SYNIX HAKKATAA INSTALL OR OPEN E huutoroo ko boɗeeje walla ko boɗeeje WinGet ubidzz.Synix. To tawtoreeki fayl ɗon wi'a heɓugo laawol, ɓortoo haala Synix ngam huutore laawol ngol bana boɗɗum, nden fuɗɗita. Jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo folder e kubaruuji software jamma to caɗeele ɓeydi.
Taa halki baylitol server'en malla halki kulol ngam haɓɓugo ɗum.
SMARTSCREEN A warnuki kalfinaaji waawata hokkugo More info → Run anyway, depending on Windows policy. Hannde jaaynde nde'e walaa daliila dow fayl go'o haani. Tabitin ko'e manngal ngal e ɗaɓɓitol habaru nden yeeso tuubuki to ɓe njaltata.
SMART APP CONTROL Ɗu'um waaway sakkugo app to Windows waawataa tabbitinki goɗɗum. Hande nden walaa ɓeydaade app go'o hawti e SmartScreen's Run anyway. Taa hallu hujjaaji jammu Windows ngam waɗugo Synix tan.
ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAILER Waɗu jaɓɓorgo ko goonga e defte. Ndaa tagdi huutore woni huutore fota sabu fayl ngol noddiraa Synix. Haasji SHA-256 je ɗon haaki ɗon anndina fayil je ɗon maɓɓiti; ko o taƴataa tabbitol e code signing.
Wondira huutoreeje e laabi hawruki bee jaɓɓorgo yimɓe. Toɗɗitaaki hawtaade e ko'e feere-feere walla toɗɗitaago huutoreeji hash.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
E huutoroo Settings → Backups for a complete Synix export/import. Ɗu'um feere to jaɓɓorgo deftere server go'oto ɗon.
HIIRA ko haani huwtoreede Ko haɓɓooji jaayndeeji ɓurna C:\Synix. server custom ko fayluuji backu-back ɓaawo ɗum e jaɓɓorgo juulde hawtaade ngam huutoraade feere. Ngaree laawol maɓɓe yeeso fuɗɗam. Firooji Windows fuɗɗiiɗi footi haajinaade to destination.
FULNugol 1. Saki server'en e timmuki jaɓɓorgo, jaɓɓorgo, e jaɓɓorgo. 2. Suɓaa ko ɓeydaama walla jaaynde fuɗnaama. 3. Yiɗde destination fuɗɗam leggal fuɗɗam nden yi'a size e ko haani wakkati. 4. Ngam jaɓɓorgo ɓeydaama, suɓii password jaɓɓorgo be sembe ngam jaɓɓorgo e rokkata ɗum feere. 5. Ngaree ngam pakkere .synixbackup timmoode, nden tabbitin ɗum.
Yiɗee ko haani hakkilantaaku Fuuɗugo jaaynde fuɗnaama ɗon hakkilanta pakke nden ɗon wallita jaaynde fuɗnaama to account Windows yahugo.
Fuuɗugo fuɗnaange naa' ɗum ɓeydaama. Deftere juulde e logs nder maajum waaway hollaago sirru. Jaɓɓorgo Fedde Windows-ji'eeji ɓooyɗi ɗi ɓooyɗi ɓooyɗi ɗi waɗataa ɗum'en naftoraaki nder koode goɗɗe.
HINNAAL 1. Dental data Synix yahugo yahugo fu. 2. Fuli ko'e import/verification controls e suɓugo pakkere je ɗon yiɗi. 3. Ɗuuruki password jaɓɓorgo to ɓe ɗaɓɓitiri e tabbitinki paketol ngol. 4. Yi'a nokku ɗon, ko haani dow diski, nden wi'a habaruji. 5. Hokka ɗum timmoode, huutoreeji, e warugo. 6. Ndaa laawol server, portji, caltuɗe, nokkuuje jaɓɓorgo, e kubaruuji yeeso fuɗugo koo ɗume.
Jaɓɓorgo Satisfactory to anditol maako mala jaɓɓorgo je ɗon aynama hawtataako. Hokka kuje je fuɗɗam be bayaanuuji naane yaake ɓe foondi serverji je ɗum wurtini.
Duuɗol data supported keewi koppi database pre-migration. To import malla migration footi, hokka ko koppi e habaruuji warugo ngam darnuki database huwtorey wakkati Synix ɗon wurtina.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Install & Launch ɗon hawta folder server je ɓe suɓii e laabi fuɗugoji ɗi ɗon support. Jaɓɓorgo jaɓugo umroore to on anndi haala huutore nder kuugal ngol.
MAHIIRAANDE FULJINGOoje E huutore mod Advanced to haani hujjaaji raw. Jaɓɓorgo jaɓɓorgo, laabi waɗeteeɗi, e innde suɓaaji ɗi ciya yiɗi. Synix ɗon hokkata hujjaaji jaɓɓorɗi; ɓeydaago go'o nder go'o waawata waddugo haandi.
Ɗu'um fuɗɗitoto jaɓɓorgo ko'e masin, nden to'o je'aama ko'e masin, to'o je'aama. Taa ɓeyda kubaruuji nder kubaruuji ngam waɗugo ɓe ɓeydi foondugo.
FIILAAL LUNCH EXPORT Ngam tagdiji ɗi ɗon walli, Servers Options → Create Batch File ɗon winndita umroore fuɗugo ha nder script.
Deftere nde'e waawataa hawtuki passwordji jaajotooɗi malla tokenji kuugal ngam o waawi huuwugo hoore mum. Hokka ɗum go'o, boo ndaaraɗum yeeso to a hokkataɗum.
Jaɓɓorgo script fuɗɗam Synix ɗon hokkataa jamɗe huutore Synix fuu, hakkilantaaku watchdog, backups, malla jaɓɓorgo. Taa huuwugo ɗum nder wakkati Synix ɗon woodi server ɗon huuwugo.
LONGO'O DUNGAAL Won e profileji fijirde ɗon fuɗɗina kuutorɗe maɓɓe ngam waɗde e jokkude serboor, e nokku laawol serboor gootol tan. Kuutorɗe ɗee mbaawi naamnaade yamiroore keeriiɗe, e mbaawi haɗde jaltinde fiilde fuɗɗorde. Tokku tinndinoore fijirde nde profile ngal hollata. Woto lomtin kuutorgal ngal e fiilde gollirnde feere walla porogaraam hakunde.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
E huutoree kaɓirgal jaɓɓorgo. Ɗum hawti e .NET runtime je Synix yiɗi; servers game haani haaje hakkilantaaki maɓɓe.
SELECT A INSTALL METHOD • MSI: Download SynixSetup.msi, wurtina ɗum, nden maɓɓita Synix Control Panel diga menu Fuɗugo. Nokkuuji jaɓɓorgo ngam huutore ko %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Huutondiral ngal e ubidzz.Synix. Kuulal WinGet Installation and Updates ɗon hawta umrooje. • Ɗuumɗinaande: Tawi ɗemngal jaɓɓorgo dowlaaku e nder foldere jaɓɓorɗe nden maɓɓita ɗum ton. Ɗuɓɓugo ko'e maɓɓaaki naa' ɗum jaɓɓugo server'en ma'a.
Jaɓɓorgo Ganndal: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
MAKKKINNDE FULJINDE 1. Caggal ko'e maɓɓaaki, ko'e maɓɓaaki, e ko'e maɓɓaaki. 2. Saki server'en juulde ma dow Synix nden maɓɓita Synix bana no haani. 3. Ɗuuruki updateer ko installer ngam laawol jaɓɓorgo je haɓi. 4. Maɓɓita Synix nden foondita to ko'e server'en e laawol'en ɗon haani.
To tawtoreejo EXE je ɗon je ɗon haandi bee MSI je ɗon haandi, fuɗɗora rakkude app je ɗon haandi. Hokka data server'en e foodaaji server'en je haani. Taa halki C:\Synix ngam ɓeydaade kuugal.
Jaɓɓorgo tawtoreeki app naa jaɓɓorgo juulde ɗe ngaɗata. Ɗuuruki kuugal Update nder server je ɓe cuɓii ngam ɗum.
To Windows anndini heɓuki hokketeeɗum nder saɗtugo kuugal, foondita to jaabawol je ɗon suɓaa ɗon ɓeyda. Ɗaɓɓitaaki ɗemngal huutoreeɗum walla jaɓɓitaago baylitol server ngam huuwugo dow hakke.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Synix ɗon ɗaɓɓa kuɗol jawdi yeeso suɓugo feere-feere ngam ɓeyduki footi ɓeydaago. To fuɗɗol ɗon laatake malla ɗon sakkiti, nanngi haala limngal ngol wi'i.
Hokka suudu ngam gooduɗo Hokka memory for Windows e background applications as well as game. Hokka nokkuure diski ngam ɓeydaago, faylji wakkatiire, jaɓɓorgo, e jaɓɓorgo.
Limti memory Minecraft ɗon kolla wakkati fijirde maako. Ɗu'um du'a je'aaki dow ko'e kuuje ɗe juulde fuu fuɗɗi.
Kuɓeeji kuɓeeji naftirtaako server nder ko'e kuɓeeji CPU/RAM koo tabitinki Windows waawataa heɓugo kuɓeeji. Eertina huutoreeji kuutorɗe e ko'e cukalel pinal fuu ngam faamugo kuugal ngal.
Network Guard Firo huutoreeji huutoreeji network ɗon ɗaɓɓa haala huutoreeji bandwidth/ resource e haalanki kuugal SteamCMD anndiraama ngam ceede huutoreeji cembiɗɗi.
Ɗum wonaa firewall, filtaral laawol, malla kuugal hakkilantaaku DDoS. Alerta naa ɗon anndina mo'o huwtata koo holla huwtata.
To a hokki habaru, wurtina kuuɗe ɗe e kuutorɗe ɗe anndaaɓe, kuutorɗe, e kuutorɗe goɗɗe. Yi'a logji je ɗon haani yeeso tuubuki laabi jammu malla network settings.

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Suɓo profil Rust nden tawtoree aduna maako, identity, gameplay, query, e tagdi bandiraaɗo yeeso fuɗɗam.
IDENTITY SERVER Synix ɗon hokkata foondiral +server.identity je ɗon haandi diga anndal server. Hokka dabareeji feere-feere e huutoreeji ngam dabareeji feere-feere ngam ɓe mbaɗataa duniyaaruji ɗi ɓe ngaɗaaki.
RUST+ Hokka App Port feere-feere ngam kuugal gooduɗo, ɓaawo ɗon toppita ko Rust yiɗi ngam huutoree e network. Luttugol maako ɗon tawaa bee fijirde yimɓe e jaɓugo RCON.
Ndaa portji ɗi ɗon haɓɓii haa jooni, ɓeyda jaɓugo sariila diga server Rust feere. Hakkiilo dow RCON e wurtina ɗum ngam wallude yimɓe ɓe jokkondira.
VANILLA E OXIDE Vanilla huutoroo fayluuji server ngal. Hono suɓugo Oxide ɓeydata dabare official support bayanuuji Steam. Framework installation naa tawtoree ko'e plugins goɗɗe.
E huutore mod & Plugin Manager's support local workflow for a detected Oxide/uMod installation. Plugins haani haa jooni ko feerootiral e ɓaleeɓe gooduɗi.
Synix ɓeydi naftoraade wakkati huutoreede Oxide ɓaawo Rust ɓeydaaki ko haɓɓii koo haɓɓitaaki to ɗum suɓii. To return to official Vanilla files, wayla suɓugo framework nden fuɗɗita kuugal Update ko Validate.
Kaŋko ɓesngu ɓesngu ko'e mawngu, hokka dunyaaji, ɓesngu, e plugin data. Wondondira ko jokkondirtee e huutoreede Oxide ɓaawo fuɗɗorgal; jaɓɓorgo ɓanngooji marɗi hollataa wonde plugins go'o hawrata no wooɗi.
